name: Astral Bear
location: 25 Bee Zone after the Lunar Obby
description: A bear that will CONSUME ALL YOUR RESOURCES
noquest_dialog: Unfortunately, I do not need any help at the moment.
In the meantime, I will just enjoy the night sky and watch the situation of my home from afar.
I will never forget what you did for me, I promise.

take: Hmm... what a peculiar individual! I wonder why I cannot read anything about you...
Oh, I apologize. Where are my manners?
My name is Sirius, but many know me as Astral Bear now.
Please, excuse my earlier rudeness. I was merely surprised.
Usually, I'm able to read anyone's past and future, but for you...
I'm unable to see anything at all. How peculiar...
No matter; you must be here in search of tasks, I suppose?
Lucky for you, I really need some ingredients for my Star Reading.
Please, bring me some essence of the moon.
going: I apologize, but I don't see you meeting my requirements.
Come back after you have all the essence.
finish: Splendid! I can give the stars my first offering.
Oh, you want to hear what my reading will be?
I could tell you, however, you might not understand much.
I want to read what is happening back home.
By "back home", I mean my old world.
Please do not look at me like that...
I swear upon the stars that it is nothing but the truth.
Hmm, it seems like the time for the first offering is due.
I will explain more later. Here is the reward for your hard work.
The small, purple ticket is for the Lunar Altar right over there. Do make sure to give it a try.

take: Back already? Well, if you feel ready for it, then it matters not.
For the second offering, I need elemental essence.
They are quite hard to come by, so it requires some dedication.
Bring them to me and I will satisfy some of your curiosity about my home.
going: I apologize, but I don't see you meeting my requirements.
Come back after you have all the elemental essence.
finish: That was rather quick.
I suppose it wasn't as much trouble as I initially thought.
Well then, let me start my story.
I come from a parallel universe-
...Stop looking at me like I am crazy, alright?
I was actually exiled by a powerful being that wants the destruction of my universe.
I am not sure what his reason is, and I also have no idea what happens there anymore.
That's why I want to ask the stars what the future has in store for my home.
...I do need quite a sizeable offering for that, though.
I will tell you more next time; it is time to continue my offering now.

take: Welcome back. We are almost halfway done.
For the third offering, I need one of those eggs that look like a precious stone.
Oh, and also one of those moon shards that you can get from the Lunar Altar.
I hope it is not too much of a bother.
going: I apologize, but I don't see you meeting my requirements.
Come back after you have all the items.
finish: [Sirius offers the items and a strong yellow glow appears around him]
Hmm... It seems like I can now reach my world with the reading.
Even though just barely, I might be able to get a glimpse.
[Sirius closes his eyes and everything around him becomes silent]
[A small yellow aura appears around him]
[After a few minutes...]
[Sirius opens his eyes and the sound of nature starts playing again]
...Impossible! H-How? So much chaos...
The situation seems to be worse than I thought.
I need a bigger offering so I can see more.
Please, return whenever you can!

take: I'm sorry to ask this of you, but I need some extremely rare items.
They should be enough to at least let me know the cause of all the chaos back home.
Please, bring me a few of the rarest items you can find!
I will await your return.
going: I apologize, but I don't see you meeting my requirements.
Come back after you have all the incredibly rare items.
finish: Thank you! Alright then, let us see the cause.
[After finalizing the offering...]
[Sirius closes his eyes and time seems to slow down around him]
[An intense yellow aura appears around him]
[After a few minutes...]
[Sirius opens his eyes and everything returns to normal]
...Corruption? The... Tree of Life got corrupted?
Impossible! How could it get corrupted?
Now I understand all that chaos...
It is unprecedented for something like this to happen.
I am able to read only small segments of the present and the past for now.
Only the future remains, so let us complete the final offering.

take: Alright, this is the last one.
I know I might be asking too much, but please bring me more moon essence and a few special essences.
I realize how hard it is, but I really need your help in order for me to see if there is any hope for my world.
I really appreciate your help.
I promise to make it up to you with a special reward.
going: I apologize, but I don't see you meeting my requirements.
Come back after you are done.
finish: Finally! No time to waste!
[After finalizing the last offering...]
[Sirius closes his eyes and time completely stops around him]
[Sirius is covered in an otherworldly glow]
[After a few minutes...]
[Sirius opens his eyes and the flow of time returns to normal]
I see... So there really is hope.
I can see someone blessed by the Tree of Life.
It seems like they are the only one able to clear the corruption.
Even though it is still uncertain that they will be able to actually save the world...
All I can do is wish them good luck.
Enough with my blabber; here is your reward.
I was able to create this bee with the leftover power from the items you just brought.
I am sure that it will help you on your journey.

name: Black Bear
description: The first bear you will ever encounter in your journey, he stands nearby the Starter Shop.

take: Oohoh.. Why, hello there, little beekeeper! Good to see a new face around here.
I am Overseer Black Bear, the caretaker of this forest.
You can just call me Berry!
I have a quest for you, one of many I give to new beekeepers like yourself.
It's simple! Don't you worry.
Go off and collect 250 pollen from the Mushroom Field right next to me, and I'll give you a wealthy reward!
And to make it easier, you can also view this quest in this little thing here
*[He hands you what looks like some kind of scroll, it sparkles slightly in your hands]*
This is your quest index, it will remind you of what you need to do, as well as keep track of your quest.
It'll update each time you're given a new quest, either from me or other bears.
It's like pure magic, right within your grasp!
Ready for your first quest? Then go forth, my friend! I believe in you.
going: I don't see your bag full yet.. come back to me when you've finished!
finish: *Sniff sniff* Wow, what a strong mushy scent!
Seems you collected all that I asked for, great job my friend!
As promised, here's your honey-licious reward.
You've officially passed your first ever quest, and earned your stripe as a beekeeper!
But there's still more to explore... More to learn.
Come talk to me again when you're ready for your next quest.
Stay safe!

take: There you are, little beekeeper! Ready for your next quest?
I'm sure you're used to collecting, but now, you'll be learning to convert it all into honey!
With the help of your bees, you can easily convert all that pollen in your bag into delicious honey right at your hive!
It marks the start of a new friendship with your bees! Isn't that marvelous, my friend?
Convert 500 of the pollen you've collected at your hive, then come back to me for a small reward.
See you in a while!
going: Seems your bag is still a bit full, friend!
I'm not going anywhere, don't worry! I'm a patient bear.
finish: Amazing work, little beekeeper!
You've gained another stripe, way to go!
Here's a little something for you and your bee's hard work, as well as a little something from me.
Keep a steady pace, beekeeper. Don't stress yourself too hard!
Speak to me again when you're ready for more quests, I'll be waiting!

take: Hello again! Eager today, are we?
Your next quest takes place in a field that's rather.. delicate.
More delicate than the rest of the fields.
Right on the other side lies the Daisy Field, the quietest, and most relaxing field of the whole forest.
A lot of us bears, as well as beekeepers like yourself, rest there in times of high stress.
Don't get too relaxed yet! There's still things to be done.
Collect 800 pollen in your bag from there, then come back to me.
Hup-hup, beekeeper! I know you and your bees can do it.
going: "Daisy daisy.. give me your answer, do.~"
"I'm half crazy, all for the love of you!~"
Oh! Still here, beekeeper. Don't worry your precious little head!
Just 800 pollen and you'll be all done with this quest.
finish: *Sniff sniff sniff* aaH- aCHOO-!
Ohh- goodness-. My apologies! A little pollen got up my nose, haha!
Amazing work, my friend. Truly working your way up! I'm so proud.
Ready for your special reward?
Here, a Royal Jelly should sufice. It helps you add new and unique bees to your hive.
When you collect bees, you'll be able to read its abilities in your index!
A must-know for all beekeepers; Understanding your bees is key to being the best beekeeper you can be.
Go forth, my friend. More awaits you in the fields!
As always, I'll have more for you when you're ready. I'll be waiting!

take: Hello hello! Welcome back, little one. You're doing so well so far!.
Let's see just how much more you can handle, off to explore a new field.
The luckiest field in the forest, the Clover Field!
Full of much luck, as well as fresh pollen.
But do beware of the caterpillars that munch on the clover leaves. They're pretty fiesty about their territory!
They still need their time to grow... But for now, avoid them as best as you can.
1,500 is a pretty big amount of pollen, but I'm sure you can handle that, can't you?
You've managed this far, a couple of silly caterpillars should be no trouble at all! Good luck!
going: Deary me.. Are you alright, friend?
Go get some water when you have a moment, then get back to the fields.
Just 1,500 pollen, you can do it!
finish: Wow.. you did it, friend! And barely a scratch, too!!
I do hope those caterpillars didn't give you much trouble, aha..
Anywho... Do you feel it yet, beekeeper? The confidence growing within you...
Feeling as if you can take on anything that stands in your path?
That is the true power of a beekeeper.
With my many years of looking over this forest, the first thing I've learnt is to never give up.
Be patient, be kind, be strong, and believe in yourself.. just like how I believe in you.
Do come back here if you ever need any more wisdom, as well as your next quest.
May luck be on your side, friend. Here is your reward, from me to you.

take: My my, beekeeper. You've been doing a lot of work lately, haven't you?.
These fields have never looked so lively in some time.
It's time we see your true Colors, my friend! The many colors of the field shall coat your swarm brightly.
How about a nice pink palette?
Collect both 2500 White Pollen and 2500 Red Pollen. Create the color of a cherry blossom...
Or a pink rose, a foxglove, perhaps!
Or maybe even a beautiful Dahlia... Just as beautiful as my dear, whos name is similar to such an eligent flower...
..o-ohhoh! Sorry, friend! Got a teeny bit distracted!..
where was I..? Oh yes, the pink pollen.
The white represents purity, while the red represensts the fierce power within. The confidence I mentioned before.
The very feeling that fuels you to push forward.
Go on now, my dear beekeeper. Your pink-coated adventures await you!
going: Doing good so far, friend. Keep going!
I know it's a lot to handle, but remember; patience is key.
finish: My goodness... now that is a lot of pollen! Your bag is almost about to overflow!
Remarkable job, absolutely remarkable!
For your fifth quest with me, I'd say you've earned your reward. As well as some wisdom...
Keep your head above the flowers, but don't forget to stop and smell them once and a while!
Breaks are always a simple bear-necessity when it comes to being a beekeeper.
Wearing yourself thin is no way to work, especially when there is still so much ahead of you.
Breathe in, breathe out... Focus on the world around you for a moment. Replenish your energy, then get back to the fields when ready.
Do not rush, for that will only complicate the balance you've upheld for yourself and make you spill your work.
Do not let it stress you. Instead, take a minute to let it inspire you to move forward.
Here is your treats, my friend. Keep going.

take: I hope you and your bees are all rested up from the last quest, this next one will prove to be a bit "prickly", haha!
On a serious note, do get some proper gear before going into this field.
I couldn't bear to see you hurt!
Today, you'll be visiting my favorite field, the Blackberry Field!
Haha, I know. A black bear loving blackberries. Where do you think my nickname comes from?
...My fur? Ha! Doesn't that make sense?
Anywho, you've gotten a lot of reds and whites, so let's try some blue!
Blue's role plays as the peace of the forest. Absolute serenity.
5,000 blue pollen, and 4,000 directly from the Blackberry Field itself. Shouldn't be hard for you considering how far you've come!
There will be some caterpillars in that field as well, but not as many as the Clover Field.
Shouldn't worry much! Hopefully soon, we'll both be seeing them burst from their coocoons and spread their wings into new life...
For this quest, I believe another Royal Jelly will do just fine.
Be mindful of the thorns, friend!
going: Don't be scared! You're doing so well so far.
Those little caterpillars are no obstacle, just a part of nature. Treat them as such, friend!
You'll be alright, you can do this!
finish: *Whistling*... Oh-! Are you finished already?
Oh, are those blackberries.. for me?
Hoho, such a kind beekeeper you are! So thoughtful, thank you my friend.
Looks like we're both getting blessings today, aren't we? Haha!
As promised, here is your jelly, and some extra honey for your stash.
A small piece of wisdom for your journey...
Not all things are as scary as you may think. Always remember to never judge a book by its cover alone.
From the big, fierce spider, to the little, teeny caterpillars. No matter how frightening they may look, it's the heart that counts.
They too have their own challenges to overcome, finding ways to defend themselves from the big, scary world.
No matter what, everyone here has a home. Even you, friend.
Keep on buzzing, beekeeper! I'll just be here on my stump munching on my snack.
Extra special berries, from a very special friend. <3

take: My, how much you've grown since we first met...
So much has happened, yet still so much to do. It's a special feeling I hold deeply to be mentoring you through this forest.
You make me so proud, friend.
Now, it is time to step things up a bit... It is time for my GRAND Trial!
Do not stress, never forget what I taught you. Patience is key to the art of collecting.
10,000 Pollen. Any color from any field.
Then, convert that 10,000 straight into honey.
This here, is my best challenge yet... For now, anyways.
If you manage to complete this, you will be heavily rewarded... With haste, my friend. I believe in you...
*Yaaawwnn...*
going: *Snoore... Snoore...*
*Mumbles* Mmh.. 10,000,, pollen...
finish: *Yaawnn..* Mm, oh.! There you are, beekeeper. And what a load of pollen you have!
Apologies, I've appeared to have taken a small nap while you were busy.
Hehe, I trust you enough to complete your quest, even with your eyes closed! You surely did not disappoint.
Your bees must be doing well too, be sure to properly feed them. They sure deserve a treat for all their hard work, too.
Here's some honey, some treats, and of course, my blessings to you.
My only piece of wisdom for you today, is this...
Love yourself, like I love you. Do not ever forget that you matter.
The forst is calling for you friend... Go, answer its call. Come back here when you're ready for another quest.

take: Y'know, my friend... My papabear always told me "It takes all colors to make a rainbow! Including the colors that coat you."
I've always taken those words to heart ever since I first heard them.. My papa trained me well, I miss him dearly.
Today, in honor of him, we'll be making our own special rainbow, with every pollen color!
10,000 of pure confidence, the fierce color of red.
10,000 of absolute purity, in all of its glory.
And... 10,000 of peace, serinity, and equality...
Add it all together, and you get 30,000 of pure pollen total, coating your hive with pride.
Your reward will be just as colorful as this quest.
Fly, my friend! Fly with the wind! Haha!
going: Hohoh, I'm already seeing the colors popping off of your gear as we speak!
Keep going, you're not done just yet!
finish: Ahh... at last... All colors into one. You've made a fine Tricolor Rainbow indeed, my dear friend.
It's a lot to carry, I'm sure. Your shoulders must be so tired...
in all my years, your courage is stronger than any I've seen before. You deserve some rest...
How does... 20,000 honey sound, friend? And some treats for your friends.
As well as, of course, some piece of wisdom.
Never be afraid to show your true colors.
If there are those who just cannot handle such brightness, they they are not worth your time.
However... You may come to find those who are just as colorful as you!
And that is a special bond that is not easily achieved, but possible.
It's the kind of bond that you've earned with me...
*Bows* I bow to you and your courageousness, friend. As well as your colorfully kind heart...
Go rest up, friend. We still got more to do.

take: *Munch, munch...* OOoh- aha- hot-! Oohoh-..
O-ohoh, didn't see you there! *Cough* I'm currently trying these "fire-packed" crimson berries my friend Spear gave me.
I figured they should still be mild enough to snack on, but boy have they proved me wrong! Oohoh-!
C-Certainly "Spiced Up" my day, I'll tell ya that much-. Never hurts to try something once, right? O-ow..
Safe to say these aren't for me, though.
*Gulp, gulp.. gulp...* *Ahem...* Anywho, your next quest does involve some fire itself!
Let's work on gathering up some red pollen, 12,000 from any red field should do!
And to give ya a bit of extra luck, 15,000 regular ol' pollen from Clover Field. I wonder how those caterpillars are doing by now...
Ooh-! *Cough* And, to give you some rest, 15,000 from the calm and collected Daisy Field.
*Gulp.. gulp...* Phew!..
Wow, 42,000 pollen across the board! Looks like you got a lot to collect, friend!
Now go on, beekeeper. Those fields of pollen simply won't pollenate themselves!
Don't worry about me! My mouth is slowly cooling down.. slowly...
going: *Gulps down a large glass of water* Guhh..! Goodness...
M-mh, don't worry! I'm alright, just keep going on your venture! I'll be.. *cough* right here..
WOW, what a punch those berries give..!
finish: Hohoo.. Very impressive, my friend!
Oo-hoh, oh dear-, I think even see a bit of your bag on fire!! Turn around, quickly!
*Throws his last little bit of water on the burning part of your bag, it sizzles away* Phew.. That was close.
Talk about being on fire! Hah.. ahh.
Oh dear.. don't worry. Here, have some water for your troubles.
As well as some Royal Jelly, and of course some honey. You've earned it all.
My wisdom for today... Try everything at least once. As the saying goes, "Don't knock it till you've tried it!"
You can decide on whether you like it or don't after the fact.
However... Don't forget to also look after yourself.
Sometimes, there are some things that just won't spark that curiousity out of you right away.
Do not let others try to force that spark out of you, take it at your own pace.
Perhaps, instead.. be the positive spark that inspires others to try new things, too.
Without being forceful, of course.
Keep "bee'ing" yourself, and light those sparks within others!

quests.name: The Legend of the Silver Eggs

take: Hello, beekeeper! I have a small tale to tell, if you please...
Take a seat amongst the grass. This'll take but a mere moment...
Long before beekeepers like you came along, we bears have been the ones to look after the bees, the fields, and keeping the pollen balance.
Us bears have been the sole protectors in our own ways, some playing different roles than others.
Like me, for example. I come from a line of protectors that have taken the grand role of looking after everything here.
I am the 10th of my generation to have this role, many stories have been passed down and many things have changed.
There was a change long before I was born that is something I wish to teach you for todays quest...
I'm sure you're very familiar with bee eggs by now, they used to just be those simple eggs. However, they weren't always so simple...
When the first ever beekeeper stepped into the forest, their bond with the bees was something not even us bears have witnessed before...
They had a special gift tied to them, their pure love of bees strenghened their powers ten fold.
Before long, that love and care even effected the eggs themselves. As if that love bred into the bees own dna.
It was then the very first Silver Egg was created, a rarity amongst all bee eggs.
Since then, that love has evolved, and their rarities kept stacking. Silver, Gold, Diamond...
Today, I have one of these special Silver Eggs to give to you as a sign of my gratitute for your work, and for you to take care of your own special bee.
Isn't that exciting, beekeeper? Before long, you may have many of these yourself one day!
But to earn this one, you must work hard for it.
EVERYTHING must be collected, every field here residing in this zone.
5,000 Mushroom Pollen, 10,000 Daisy Pollen, 10,000 Clover Pollen, 12,000 Blackberry Pollen.
And of course, the Tricolored Rainbow. 15,000 of all Red, White, and Blue pollen.
Conquer the Blackberry Field for 12000 pollen. And convert 20000 pollen.
Now is your time to write your legacy, to prove more that you are a master of your hive, and a grand caretaker of your bees.
Are you ready, friend?
going: Your bond with your bees is only growing stronger, keep going friend! You're doing marvelously!
finish: My goodness gravy... you've done it. You have done it!
Each and every field conquered in one go, all that conversion work... All, finished.
I... am truly speechless... brings a tear to the eye, it does...
Well.. *sniff*.. I do still have, some words- of course.
Carrying all of that pollen in pure harmony deserves the finest of rewards.
Here be your newest friend to add to your hive...
*He gently holds the delicate egg with his two, soft paws, slowly handling it into your hands.*
My friend, my friend.. take good care of this young one.
And may this bee take good care of you...
My wisdom today, is something special... Take care of those as you yourself wish to be treated.
With kindness, with love, with care...
You might just make someones day, or even change their life forever...
Keep pushing along, my friend... take good care of yourselves.

take: Back for more, I see? Hmmhmm, hope you've had a nice rest, friend! You need it for this next one.
Today, we are venturing onto new horizons... meaning a new field is in store for you!
You'll be learning more about the sun's rays as you walk into the Sunflower Field.
If you think these fields get a lot of sun, just you wait for the sun to reeally hit ya in this one!
Please be sure to bring plenty of water on your jounrey, you'll indeed-y need it.
And maaaaybe some sunscreen, too!
This is the biggest number I'll be giving you so far. 40,000! What a feat!
The sun will feel a blazing hot, but don't be afraid of it. For it is helping to guide you forward.
You're already capable of so much, I know you can overcome this quest next...
Be sure to collect some sunflower seeds while you're there! Your bees will enjoy those a ton.
going: The shine in your eyes is shining brighter than ever, as bright as gold!
You've got this, you've come so far!
finish: My... sweet honeysuckle... Every last speck of pollen, all in one bag...
Not even the scorching heat could stand in your way, my friend.
Your determination keeps surpising even this old bear. And I've seen quite a lot in my time. Be proud of your work!
No new wisdom for today friend, but.. I still grant you my blessings.
As well as 30,000 honey, and some treats for your dearest compainions.
The sunflower field has a new legend now. And its name... is yours, beekeeper.

take: Off to another quest! I believe it's time to cool off a little, don't you agree?
Another new field, and it should keep you nice and chill after all that heat you've endured.
You may also encounter a new buggy friend in there, known as the Rhino Beetles!
They certainly are a feisty bunch, but don't fret! With the trust of your bees, you can handle anything.
Just be careful not to harm them toooo terribly much, okay? Just enough to show you mean buisness!
You'll be spending a lot of time in that field, as you'll have just 75,000 to collect!
Aha, I know, it's a lot!
These numbers will only get higher the more quests you're on, but I know you're prepared to handle it all.
Go on, my friend! I'll be here waiting patiently for your return.~
going: Carry on, carry on!
Enjoy the cool breeze while your there, you got this...
finish: Haha, there you are! Did that breeze feel just ohh so nice on ya?
Those flowers are a pretty bunch, too! Quite rare specimins from what Dalilah has told me.
Such incredible work, from such an incredible little beekeeper. Never failing to surprise me!
Now for all that work, here's some more honey to equal up all you've collected today.
A sweet treat is in order too! Here's some of those for your bees and their hard work.
Take care of yourselves, see you next quest!

take: Greetings once again, my friend... I hope you and your bees have rested your wings well.
Yes, yes. Even you have wings, in your own special way.
It's time to face the sun yet again, as well as a hardy challenge for one like yourself.
With how many quests you've done so far, I sense you're one for any challenge!
You've grown familiar with Daisy Field, but I'm sure 50,000 isn't a number you'd expect from a place so gentle...
That field will give you your time of rest, as for the Sunflower Field...
I will remind you, that you are free to take breaks.
If you start getting too hot, step out for a while to rest your mind...
And, even if you don't get too hot, take a small break anyways.
Maybe even switch between fields to help steady your balance.
It never hurts to push yourself, but remember the balance of this forest.
These quests take time, a lot of it. Remember your patience, friend. For it is the biggest strength to have while being a beekeeper.
Go now, these fields await you...
going: Ohoh dear, I know it's a lot... I assure you, I understand the struggle.
Even I was once a collector, one of the many things I had to do before earning my role as an overseer!
Come now, friend. If you need rest, you may rest with me. Go and continue when you feel ready to.
finish: Well, well. There it all is... I knew you could do it.
So much pollen to carry, I suggest converting if you haven't already!
I'm so proud of how far you've come... I know I've said this a ton by now, but do be proud of yourself, too.
A couple of Royal Jellies, and of course, more honey. You've earned every single drop of it, friend.
Heheh, I had no doubts, none in the world about your abilities.
Go rest, friend. For there is always more to come.

take: Oho, time to get back into my favorite field again!
Ahh, the Blackberry Field. Filled with delectible treats, as well as full to the brim with blue pollen.
You've explored there before, surely those thorns will give you no trouble at all now!
Just 60,000 will do. Nothing more, nothing less!
You'll also be stopping by at the blue flowers field, 125,000 pollen needs to be collected.
185,000 in total! You've got your hands full with this one, friend.
Mmm, I can smell the blackberries from here... Go forth, complete your next quest!
going: *You see him munching away on some blackberries, pure joy fills his expression*
Mmhmm, now that is a good berry!
finish: *Finishes up the last berry in his paw, then looks right back at you*
Oho, there you are! I knew you could manage all of that.
Nothings stopping you now, not even the thorns of the blackberry vines.
Boy, am I in a chipper mood today!
This is the most I've given you thus far, friend. 110,000 pure, untouched, uneaten, golden honey.
Take a good look at your achievements, friend. Feel that determination flow within you like the honey flowing in your stash.
Come back to me when you're ready for your next challenge, my friend. May the sweetness of the blackberries strengthen your power!

take: Ooohohoh boy... it's time to get FIERCE for this next quest, beekeeper!
It's time for your red-filled quest to begin, taking place in the Red Flowers Field.
Surely you've seen it next to the Blue Flowers Field, haven't you? Perhaps took a peak to see the ladybugs?
Just like Blue Flowers, you won't be alone in there. Be careful where you step!
They say ladybugs give you much luck, so take it as a sign, friend...
Just need 100,000 Red Pollen, and 150,000 from the Red Flowers field.
Should be a piece of cake for you, considering where you stand now!
Still, I wish you good luck. May the blaze within you burn as bright as the sun.
going: 100,000 Red Pollen AND 150,000 from the Red Flowers Field — all fire, no mercy!
250,000 total and every single one is red. The blaze is waiting — GO!
finish: Phew... That was a load of fire, wasn't it friend?
Least you didn't fully set ablaze like you almost did last time, hoho!
Ohh, your bees must be weary after such a task...
I suppose they deserve more treats n' treasures, don't you think?
My wisdom for today is this; Remember to be open and honest if something is wrong, never be afraid to tell the truth if needed.
There may be others who need to hear it, even if it's hard to hear at first...
If the fire is left unchecked, it may spread a load of negativity towards others, even yourself!
Truth hurts sometimes, but it's better than spreading something that may not be true just to make you and others happy.
Stay safe, beekeeper. Thank you for all your hard work.

take: Hmmhmm, thought we were done with Red Flowers, were we?
Not just yet, got a little more in that field to go. As well as, of course, another stop in my favorite field again!
That should mix things up a bit, shouldn't it? Hmmhm!
75,000 in Blackberry, 200,000 in Red flowers (ohoh, yes I know that's a lot-), and 150,000 overall red pollen.
Complete this, my friend. And you'll be rewarded handsomely, as always.
As your dearest mentor, I say; go forth, and shine on!
going: *You see him playing with a little ladybug in his paw, before gently placing them down on a leaf nearby*
*It then takes flight back to the red flowers field*
He watches it in awe, then looks back at you*
Go now my friend, let that fire guide you to new horizons! Travel along, just like that little ladybug.~
finish: *He claps his paws in applaud* Marvelous job, friend! Absolutely supurb!
Such masterful work, indeed! Hoho!
Op-! Almost fell off my stump there, haha! *He rebalances himself, then properly gets off from his stump*
Now excuse me, beekeeper! There must be something that you're looking for, right?
Much more honey just like this will come your way the more you achieve.
And you've been achieving a lot, so I'm sure you're used to this by now!

take: *You see him sitting on his stump, calmly reading some kind of book in his paw*
*He then goes up to look at you, and gently closes his book, putting it aside*
Ah, the upcoming legend returns to see little old me. What a blessing, indeed!
Soon your own story will be written in a book, just like the one I was reading...
I'll gladly be the first to purchase it, hoho!
You ready for some more red and blue pollen, friend?
Ohh I knoww, it's feeling quite repetitive. But there is something a little new for you to do this one!
Let's see... 100,000 Blackberry, 250,000 Red Flowers, and 200,000 total of red pollen.
And- you must convert 150,000 of it into honey!
It's a part of the art of a beekeeper.
Sometimes going into the same field with fresh, new gear, and a full new strategy, is the most satisfying feeling in the world...
Only means you're growin', and getting better at your craft!
Now get out there and grow, you can do this!
going: 250K Red Flowers, 200K Red Pollen, 100K Blackberry, 150K converted!
700K total between collecting and converting — the flame never dies, beekeeper!
Every field. Every color. Every conversion. Don't stop until it's ALL done!
finish: Hohohoh, there's my little flame, way to go!
Now THAT is a lot of fresh honey! Such a sweet, gooey victory to behold.
With all that being said... You've been making the rounds around this forest, many bears have been hearing your name.
The more you do, the more of a true legend you're becoming. I really did mean that earlier!
It is an honor to be alongside you during this journey, I cannot wait to see what you accomplish next, friend.
Here is your hefty reward, as promised...

take: Ah, there you are friend! Isn't it such a wonderful thing to be a beekeeper?
Take a look at how much you've gathered this far.
The bond you've made with your bees, your honey stash, your legacy...
What you have comes with no easy task, friend.
However, as always our tale does not end here. Your tale will never end, but a new chapter is beginning to blossom...
Let us start with a new quest, with some more familiar fields.
*Ahem...* 300,000 Sunflower, 250,000 Blue Flower, 200,000 Daisy, and 150,000 Clover.
Then, convert 200,000 of that all into sweet, delectible honey. Got all that, beekeeper?
That equals to a total of... 900,000 pollen!
What a remarkable amount, friend... I believe you can manage that.
Much luck, much love, friend.
going: Not done yet, friend. far from it!
Don't forget to rest when you get a moment, the fields won't be going anywhere anytime soon...
finish: Hohohh... Do my eyes deceive me?
Such an unstoppable force you are, my friend... Such absolute power!
I'm left with, not much else to say besides... I'm proud of you. So, SO very proud...
*He begins to tear up a little...*
*sniff..* *Ahem...* W-Well, I say you deserve your reward after such a feat. Here, for you.
Keep chugging along, beekeeper.

take: My, ain't these bees just the sweetest little things?
So much power packed into one little body! Who knew a creature so small could make such a big impact in the world?
Some say that because of their wingspan, they shouldn't be able to fly at all! But they still continue to surprise us in many ways...
Speaking of bees, looks like a lot more conversion is needing to be done. And I mean a LOT.
A whopping 500,000 honey to be converted from pollen, half a million!. Imagine what you can do with that much in your stash.
A lot of bears would give anything to have that much to themselves...
Say, maybe when you're done-, share some with the others! I'm sure they'll appreciate such an offer of sweetness.
Go on now, get converting!
going: [You find him quietly humming to himself in such a relaxed state, not paying much attention to anything else besides the wind in his fur]
[You figure it's best to get back to your quest and give him a moment to relax]
[You then remind yourself that you too need to rest]
finish: And there it is... 500,000 honey, all in one go...
So... Astonishing. So inspiring...
You're a true bee-all natural!
Ohh, I'll never get tired of bee puns...
Here you are, my friend. From deep within my cave, a gift from me to you for all your hard and earnest work.

take: Goodness, how the time flies when you're having fun.
You've already completed half of my quests!
The mid-point of your journey is here, friend. Still got a far path ahead of you.
I won't get to the dilly dallies of the details.
You got your quest index that I gave you, don't you?
I don't need to mention them each time, it'll know! You got this, my friend.
going: Hmhmm, procasinating a little aren't we, friend?
It's okay if you can't get it all in one go, it's not like you're on a deadline! Hoho!
finish: [He stands for a moment and looks at you with absolute astonishment, then begins to applaud]
Well done, beekeeeper. You continue to amaze me with each quests.
Soon you'll be winging it far beyond these quests in no time flat!
Here is my piece of wisdom to you...
Do not let the thought of others disrupt your own self image.
People will have their opinions. Some helpful, some hurtful.
Do not let the little version of you they have in their head change who you REALLY are.
It's okay to let people have a thought of their own, do not tire yourself in trying to change that.
You are still you, and only you know yourself better than any single person you may know.
Even those who you may consider or call themselves Family.

take: [You see him sitting on his stump reading a different book in his paw]
[He notices you at the corner of his eye and looks towards you, giving a wave]
Hello again, friend! Ready for another quest?
I won't take up too much of your time, just some more simple pollen collecting as usual.
Don't be too shocked when you see the amount, you've got this in the bag!
While you're on your quest, be sure to say hi to Brown Bear for me.
Go on and give it your all! *Goes back to reading*
going: [He sits upon his stump continuing to read his book, unaware of your presense]
[It's best to leave him be to go finish your quest]
finish: [He shuts his book with a confident smile, placing it up against his stump]
[He then carefully stands up, gripping onto his cane, then looks at you with your full bag of pollen]
See that there, friend? THAT is true dedication to the craft!
I knew you could pull off such a quest, even when I was nose deep into such an interesting novel.
Here is your reward for todays work, it'll be helpful for you in the long run. Try to save up!

take: Hohoh, back again for more so soon?
I will mention that I may need to give a slight warning for this next quest...
For todays quest, you'll be taking a visit to the big, dark cave just up ahead.
Within it contains a very territorial spider, who is normally not a big fan of visitors.
Simply try to avoid as best as you can, only defending yourself if needed.
I apologize for it being such a hefty task, but I'm sure you can pull through.
Please... Look after yourself and your bees.
going: Now now, it'll be alright... I know it's scary, but I assure you there's nothing to be truly afriad of.
I know your bees got your back.
finish: Phew, my goodness you made it... And not a scratch or bite on you!
I am the type to leave these bugs be, as they are simply harmless.
But I will embarassingly admit, even the spider gives me a bit of the heebies...
There are still times where I'll come to say hi, I do not wish to treat any creature differently.
It doesn't help the small fear I have, surely they understand...:
Those spiders have been around for as long as this forest has existed, if only they can speak...
Maybe then my fear wouldn't be such a heavy burden, haha!
Anyways, for your bravery, here is your reward. Wonderfully done, friend.

take: Do you hear that, friend? The wind is blowing strong.
So strong, I can hear bells from a distance! Those must be the bluebells I hear.
It looks like that field really IS calling for you!
Those flowers rarely ever properly ring out, so I believe it's suiting for your quest to take place there.
Answer the call of the bells, they await you!
going: It's a joy to hear all those bluebells ring!
Though, I suppose that means you aren't finished with your quest, isn't that right?
Don't let their ringing scare you, friend. You'll grow to love their resonant ringing.
finish: Goodness, seems they've finally quieted down...
Such a beautiful sound they make, don't you think?
And so much pollen from there, too!
Here's your reward as always, keep up the great work!

take: Now I'm sure you know me as someone who loves blackberries...
...but I too enjoy a Strawberry from time to time as well!
You'll be taking a visit to the Strawberry Fields, surely they're nice and ripe around this time.
Canvy always loved the Strawberry Fields the most. She says their red is the "Most vibrant of her primary colors!"
While you're there, be sure to pick me some! I'd enjoy a little mix in my diet.
going: Mmmm, I can smell the scent of strawberries on you already.
But not enough! Feel free to help yourself to some strawberries while you're there if you're feeling weary.
There's plenty for everyone!
finish: Mhmm, thank you my friend! Such a sweet-berry job you've done. Hoho!
[He takes some of the strawberries you gave him and mixes them in his pouch full of blackberries]
There we are, if only I had some blueberries to add into this...
Ooo! Maybe we should grow a dedicated blueberry field one day!
Anywho, just rambling to myself here, dear friend.
Here's your own treat too. Cheers!

take: Hmhmm, it has been a while since I've last properly tested you, hasn't it?
This next list of quest is nothing to mess around with, my friend.
This'll be another ultimate test of your strengh thus far.
You may think this is a little too soon, but I believe it is the perfect time.
Better get started, dear beekeeper!
going: Come rest with me for a second, friend.
I've given you a lot, and it's okay that it's taking some time to complete.
What I want this to teach, is that you shouldn't focus so hard on your end goal and nothing else.
Let yourself appreciate the journey you're on! The sights you're seeing. The friends you're making!
Then, before you know it, you'll be finished with your quest.
And it'll feel like it took no time at all.
finish: Ahh, at last... You've finally completed it!
Did you enjoy your time? Have some nice experiences?
I hope so, friend. This is all for fun, after all.
You're ready for just about anything at this rate!
Do take a rest, you've earned it after so much collecting.
Come back to me when you're ready for more, you're only getting better.

take: Think it's time for another trinity mission?
A good balance of the pallette always makes a good quest...
... Or, maybe I'm just running out of things to do sometimes. Hohoh, silly me!
I will admit, these are quests I do make up on the spot, but there are some that our thoroughly planned out.
Despite this being something you've done before, you still got a lot to collect.
Good luck!
going: Red, White and Blue... Why do those colors feel familiar?
Hmm... Oh well!
finish: And even with a lack of ideas, you still got that inspiration in you to get it all done.
I suppose it is easier to follow someone's direction than it is to make your own, isn't it?
Oh! Would you look at that! You're the one teaching me wisdom now! Oohoho!
Ooh, it does make me glad to see you in such high spirits.
Let's keep it going into the next quest, friend.

take: *Sniff, snifffff...* Hohoh wow! Snowflake's really taking good care of those roses. I can smell them from here!
Such a beautiful scent, reminds me of Delilah's purfume...
...Mhmmh annywho, let's go pick out some roses, shall we?
We'll be taking a visit to the Rose Field, up where Polar Bear lives.
Just need to be veeerryy careful picking them out. Take it from me, they don't feel too great in the paw!
going: Oh dear, did you get pricked by some of their thorns?
It's okay friend, they don't mean to harm you.
Give yourself time to heal, and give it another go when you're ready.
finish: There we go! Are your hands alright?
Even with those gloves, those thorns can poke right through sometimes!
Be sure to wash and bandage them right up, hopefully your reward shall help you along a little.
Keep going strong, my friend!

take: Have you ever made something with pinecones before?
Canvy uses them to make the best wreaths imagineable!
Token collects them for keepsake, Snowflake uses them for herbal tea...
And Spear eats them straight from the tree!
I really do wonder what kind of taste they have...
If Spear and the bees like them so much, maybe one day I can give it a shot!
Anywho, go and get pickin'!
going: [Berry doesn't seem to notice you as he picks a Pine Cone up from the ground with a curious look.]
[He glances around a couple of times, and takes a large bite out of it with a loud crunch.]
[...It's hard to tell if he's enjoying it or not.]
finish: *Cough cough* mHm-, oh! Hello friend.
Pardon me just a moment, my throat is, a little rough now.
Hm? Pine Cones?
Oh! Yes! Your quest! Silly me, I got distracted by aaahh...
No need to worry about that, ahaha! Great job on collecting so much, here's your- *cough* quest reward.
Hohh, I'm parched...

take: Brrhrhrh, feel that cold breeze? That must be coming from Snowflakes Snowdrop flowers...
It is nice to feel on such a hot day, but somehow it's feeling like winter already!
Try not to ffreeze your stingers off with this quest, dear friend.
You'll be marching head on into the s-snow, so be sure to get the proper boots!
Bbrgh, and do not forget to try and stay warm! I'm- sure the sun will still cover.
going: Mmhm, c-cold getting to you a little, friend?
That's quite alright, it can give even me the c-chills sometimes.
Don't worry though! I've heard from Snowflake they can actually h-heat themselves if there's enough!
That'll feel nice, won't it?
finish: Phew... There we are. Kind enough for Snowflake to give us some of their warm cocoa.
And it looks as if I remembered correctly, all those Snowdrops do heat a little once they really get going.
Such a strange decision to move from such polar climates, to out here under the warm sun in the forest.
Such a kind and prescious soul... Can't help but love the lad.
Now here's my own treats for you, my friend. Stay toasty!

take: I sense another big test coming.
Yes, another test set up nicely by the three new fields you've just explored!
Rosey reds, chunky pinecones, and chillful snowdrops.
Hope you're prepared to tackle them again, friend!
Remember what we've learnt from them along the way, from all those other fields.
Good luck, beekeeper!
going: A tall order to have, scouring three new fields for so long.
Don't worry too much friend, soon you'll know these fields like the back of your paw too!
Er, hand, I suppose. Haha!
finish: Hmm, let's take a look here...
[He looks at the progress of your quests and finds himself delighted at their completion totals being reached]
Hmhmm, how delightful... Outstanding work, friend.
Another small piece of wisdom as closure to this quest...
It's always good to practice new skills, especially when exploring new places often.
Soon they'll become habit, and even sooner, they'll feel like another home.
The more you practice, the more it becomes second nature.
Muscle memory is truly a magnificent thing!
Be sure to put it to good use, friend.

take: As we reach the end, we still venture on to new territory...
Today, my friend, you'll be visiting the ever-tall Bamboo Field.
My good friend Spear resides there, perfectly still at his post.
Once you get to know him, you'll learn that deep down inside that hard-grown shell...
He is a soft and tender bear.
That field he stays at has a great history with ones like him.
Be sure to show him, and the fields some compassion.
going: Got to see Spear yet?
I've always enjoyed the serenity of the Bamboo fields.
So still and stoic, and such firm plants they are.
Much like the one protecting them, oohoho!
finish: There you are, I can tell you're finished already.
Hmhm, something about your stance. It seems, stronger...
More bold than I've seen you before?
My my, have you been practiciing with Spear? Hohoh, how sweet.~
Let him know I say Hello next you see him!
Here's your rewards, keep fighting on!

take: Here's a funny one for you, how about a trip to Banana Fields?
Our forest has the BIGGEST and brightest bananas out there, all kept in that field.
Hohoh, imagine slipping on a banana of that stature.
You'd be sliding for hours!
Ohoh, ohh- go on my friend! See if you can take one for yourself!
going: [You find Berry in a laughing fit with himself]
Ooohoho! Ooh, hello friend!
I was just preoccupiated with my imagination.
I couldn't help imagining you gettin whisked away by one of those banana peels ooh-, oOohohohoo!!
[Seems he might be at this for a while]
finish: Ohohoh, there you are! Didn't slip up at all, did you?
Ohh I kid I kid, you did quite good, friend. Very ripe job, haha!
Come now, come grab your treats...
Op-! *Slips* Oof... Ough... Looks like you got one after all..!
A small one, but one nonetheless...
Oof... Don't worry about me, I'm alright! I may be old, but I won't go down THAT easily!

take: Alrighty, now for a real fuzzy challenge...
From the polar opposite end, now comes the Raspberry Field.
I do still and always will enjoy my blackberries, but they're also quite a nice snack.
Just not a big fan of how sour and bitter they can be compared to them...
You can grab some if you'd like still, but maybe save them for Spear.
He enjoys those berries more than I do, hohoh.
going: Oh? You've seen Canvy near the Raspberry Field?
Ahah, that makes a lot of sense.
She loves the smell of all the ripe raspberries. She says it relaxes her very nicely.
Just like me and my blackberries.~
finish: Ooh, still want me to have some too?
Oh alright, just a couple for the berry stash won't hurt.
Great job on collecting as always, I've forgotten how far into the quests you're in already...
What number is this one? 33? Wow, what a ways we've gone...
Keep going my friend, you're almost close to the end.

take: Say, beekeeper. Are you feeling lucky today?
How's about a trip back to an old field?
Go get some pollen back at good old Clover Field, boost your luck up a little!
Who knows, maybe you'll finally find a three leafed clover in there!
Since the field is already full of four leafed ones, haha!
going: [Berry stares up into the sky, seemingly lost in thought]
Aah, how lucky I am to have such wonderful friends...
finish: You're back! Had any luck out there?
No? No three leafed clover? Ohh I'm sure one day you'll find it.
I'm sure you're still feeling pretty lucky nonetheless, friend!
Inching closer to the end now... Don't sweat it, you've got this.

take: Hmm, looks to me you may be in need of some more royal jellies.
Well, for this special occasion, I'll give you some, and then some!
A rare delicacy, a sparkily delight... The Shiny Jelly!
If you can complete this task, you'll have your very own to give to one of your companions.
As well as a couple of starflower seeds that I found while you were off in the Clover Field...
Looks as if that luck shared onto me, hoho! So now, I share with you.
I have faith in you, my friend.
going: [He holds up the two Starflower seeds in his paws up to the sun, admiring the sparkle that comes off of them]
Woow... Such a beautiful, vibrent coloring...
[He seems almost in a complete trance by them]
finish: My my, what a load of pollen you have... You and your bees managed to collect all that?
I shouldn't be so surprised, but... Hoh, somehow I still am!
That's a lot of pollen for a beekeeper of your size, that much collecting deserves the bestest of rewards.
Here you go, my friend... The rarest jelly of them all, the Shiny Jelly.
May the luck be on your side, and gain you a special shiny new friend.

take: Mhmhmm, let's keep going with the more unique places, shall we?
I believe it's time for another trip to the spider field...
As well as bamboo, to mix things up even further.
It would be wise to remember Spear's training if you've managed to learn that yourself.
Tread carefully, friend. Come back safe!
going: Feeling okay?
Don't fret friend, the spiders used to give me the shakes when I was younger too.
I've come to learn that, they have no real intent to hurt anyone.
They're just feisty about their territory, is all.
I certainly would be a little jumpy if someone barged into my cave unannounced! Oohoho!
finish: There it is! Oh-, dear, are you okay?
It certainly looks like those spiders got you a little bit.
Hm? You're alright?
If you say so, friend. I'm very proud of how far you've come.
Here's your rewards, make sure to rest up, okay?
You need to be 100% for these next few quests. You're almost there after all!

take: My... what a beautiful sky up there.
So still and pure, so much to take in all at once.
Hm? My ear twitches to a familiar sound as well.
That's right friend, the bluebells toll again!
Go follow them and their pure, resonant sounds.
Let them guide your quest to swift completion.
going: [Berry rests very heavily on the stump, sitting still with his eyes closed]
[Seems the bells have put him to sleep]
finish: ...hhmHm?
Ooh, good morning friend!
I appear to have dozed off while you were away, haha!
The bluebells have quieted down, I take it you've finished your work then?
Wonderful, here's some extra for everything you've done.
*Yawns* Apologies for being a little brief, friend.
That was a really good nap.

take: Mhm, you know, dear friend.
You're nearing the end of everything I can teach you.
It really is bittersweet, for our time to be so close to being over when you think about it.
But, as I've always believed myself, it's best to live in the present moment.
To appreciate where you are and what it took to get you here.
Much like the very first piece of wisdom I gave you way back when;
"Keep your head above the flowers, but don't forget to stop and smell them once and a while!"
...What do you say, friend? Want to have a small trip down memory lane?
Let's go and smell some familiar flowers.
going: Hhmhm~, what a pretty and wonderful day it is.
No better way to spend it than being out with a friend!
Come on, let's keep going.
finish: Aaah, that was nice, wasn't it?
I actually haven't explored the Rose Field in a quite a long while.
It was nice to see Snowflake again, I hope he has a spendlid day taking care of his fields.
...I apologize if this is out of nowhere, friend, but-
Thank you, for letting me tag along for this quest
It was wonderful to watch how you've been growing so much.
See you soon, here's to our wonderful day today!

take: Hello again, friend!
Feeling ready to take on another day?
Ooh, don't stress yourself much with how little is left.
Believe me, it weighs on my mind too.
But what else is there to do besides keep moving forward, hm?
Let's go explore some more recent fields, as a reminder of how far we've come.
Ooh don't worry about me. I may be old, but that just means the fields' residents respect me, haha!
going: Don't rush, friend.
Breathe, it's ok to take your time.
You've done so many great things already, let's keep going and do even more.
finish: Hooh, what a journey that was!
I knew already you had it in you to protect yourself, but my goodness I just could not look away.
Your swift and steady movements, and dedication to doing everything as perfectly as possible.
Truly, a marvel to witness again.
*Sniff* ...Oh-, don't worry, friend.
Just a little emotional, is all.
[Berry wipes his eyes once and looks at your with a gentle expression, smiling warmly]
See you soon, friend.

take: Well beekeeper... This is it.
The final test of all you have learnt with me thus far.
Such a journey we went on, you and I... I never want you to forget it.
I, certainly know I won't...
I'm so proud of how far you've come, the things you've accomplished...
It's enough to make a grown bear cry...
And I... Hoh... Believe me, I am not one to hold back tears, but, I'll try to hold them for now...
You have much to be doing, friend. Please... Take your time, savor these moments...
...You're free to stay here as much as you like before venturing out there, of course.
But, maybe I just say that because I wish to hold onto this for just a little longer.
...Hah, I know it's not wrong of me to want that, friend.
Thank you, for your concern though.
Don't worry about this old bear, the last thing I want to do is stunt your growth.
Go... I know you'll do great.
going: [He sits upon his stump looking down at the ground, meditating for a while]
[You can feel his confidence in you from where you stand]
finish: Mhm, and there you go.
I always knew you'd reach the end like this.
It's just, mhm-
[Berry's voice begins to shake a small bit, as a small amount of tears well up in his eyes]
Hoohoh... come here friend.
[He steps down from his stump and pulls you into a big bear hug]
[It's comforting, warm, safe]
[And smells faintly of blackberries]
I am so proud. So, so very proud, to see another one of you reach such heights.
To help raise you up there myself, and for you to take off, soaring higher than I always expect.
[You can hear him speaking through a great smile on his face]
[He pulls away from the hug, slowly sitting himself back up onto his stump]
*Sniff* It's just such a beautiful experience, more beautiful than any part of this forest.
One I'm so glad to have witnessed again.
It's time for you to explore, friend.
To find parts of this forest that not even I know about yet, and to hone your skills into something that will inspire others.
And, as a parting gift, if you wouldn't mind, friend.
I'd like to leave you with one last piece of wisdom.
One I hold very dearly to my heart.
...Remember all of the good in your life.
You've gone through so much hardship in your time with me, a lot of struggle to get to the end.
But amongst it all, you had many, many bright moments of sunlight. Of beautiful, happy sunlight.
Keep those brightest memories, those happiest days, close to your heart.
Think of them every chance you get, especially when you may feel blue, and gloomy.
...There's nothing worse to feel than feeling like there are no more good times to have in the future.
That once all of, this, is over, there won't be anything else to spark joy.
That's why reminding yourself of the good times had, will help keep your head up hopeful for the future good times to come.
Because, I promise you, dear friend.
Even though our quests together may be completed...
There will always be more good times to come.
And if something in your head doubts that fact.
Let the past prove you wrong!
Enjoy being wrong about what those nasty thoughts tell you!
After all, if the good times really were over..
You wouldn't have felt such motivation to get here, would you?
...I love you, dear friend.
Come visit me any time you wish.
I'll always have time for wonderous beekeepers like yourself!
...Stay safe out there.

name: Brown Bear
description: Brown Bear is the second ever bear you will encounter, he is located right at the start of the 5 Bee Zone, his quests are more focused on gathering tokens and using abilities, making his quests more time consuming.

take: Oh! A new rookie! Hey there!
I'm Token, the local Forest Ranger around these parts!
Some people know me as Brown Bear, but Token's my Ranger name!
See this satchel? It's my prized possession, but it's looking way too empty right now.
I'm on a mission to fill it up with cool stuff from the woods!
But hey, a good Ranger always keeps the fields in tip-top shape first.
The Clover Field is getting a bit overgrown with Red Flowers, and it's throwing off the local ecosystem.
Mind heading over there to clean it up a little?
Of course, you will receive a reward for it too, so don't you worry!
going: Ah-ah, not so fast little buddy! You're not done just yet.
I can still see plenty of overgrown Red Flowers from all the way over here.
Keep those bees buzzin' and don't slow down until that patch is looking clean and pristine!
finish: Wow, look at how clean the field looks now!
Good job out there on your very first mission.
You've got some serious potential, rookie!
Here's your reward, as promised.
Come back when you're ready to help me fill my satchel even more!

take: Welcome back, rookie!
Now that you've got the basics down, it's time for the real fun to begin.
You see, whenever your bees make honey or gather pollen, they sometimes leave behind these super shiny Honey Tokens.
And as you already know, my satchel has a lot of free space inside.
Mind heading back out there and collecting a few of them for my collection?
going: Those Tokens won’t jump into my satchel by themselves, you know?
I'll be waiting for you right here.
Don't make me wait too long!
finish: Wow, just look at them shine!
They're even more beautiful up close than I remembered.
You have a talent for it!
These are going straight into the front pocket of my satchel!

take: Hey, rookie! You're really getting the hang of this Ranger lifestyle.
I actually just got back from patrolling the deeper parts of the woods, and guess what?
The wild strawberries are finally ripe!
That means the fields are dropping those bright red Strawberry Tokens right now.
They're super vibrant, and honestly, they would look absolutely amazing next to my Honey Tokens.
What do you say we make a deal?
Go snag a few of them for me, and I'll make sure you get a sweet payout!
going: Still hunting for those strawberries, rookie?
Keep tracking them down, I know you can do it!
finish: Just look at that color, they're completely flawless!
If you ever want to become a Forest Ranger, tell me and we can take care of it!
*Takes a bite* Ahh... perfect. Absolutely perfect.

take: Whoa, you're moving through these missions fast!
Since you did so well with the strawberries, I've got a slightly bigger challenge for you this time.
I'm trying to balance out the colors in my satchel.
Can you track down some Blueberry and Pine Cone Tokens for me?
going: Not too fast! You're not done yet!
Come back when you find all of them.
finish: Wow, look at that perfect color balance!
My collection is really starting to look like a proper Ranger's stash now.
Keep up the amazing work, here's a little something for your troubles.

take: While checking the perimeter earlier, I noticed some mischievous bugs roaming around the fields.
They've been causing quite a bit of trouble for the local wildlife.
So I would appreciate it if you and your bees go and keep them in check.
They sometimes drop Treat Tokens too!
I know bees absolutely love snacking on those treats to grow stronger, but honestly?
They would make an awesome addition to my collection.
Please go teach those pests a lesson and bring me some!
going: Watch your step out there, those mobs can be pretty feisty!
Stay on your toes and keep your guard up.
Your bees will be doing the heavy lifting anyway.
finish: Awesome, you handled those bugs and came back with these beautiful tokens!
I almost feel a little guilty taking these away from your hungry bees... almost!
You did a phenomenal job keeping the fields safe today.

take: Look at you go, rookie! You're turning into a top-tier field assistant.
Looking at my satchel reminds me exactly of my old Cub Scout uniform.
I used to spend weeks out in the woods just trying to earn a single shiny new badge to sew onto my vest!.
That's honestly where I got my obsession with collecting these tokens.
For this mission, I need a big stack of Honey Tokens, and a few more Treat Tokens.
As we used to say back in my scouting days: "Let your mark grow and prosper!"
Let's see you make your mark on this hunt. Think you can handle it?
going: Don't back down, rookie!
I believe in you!
finish: Whoa, that's a serious haul!
My satchel has never felt this heavy before.
You remind me of how eager I was back in Cub Scouts.
Keep it up! You're doing great!

take: You're becoming quite the reliable partner, rookie!
Watching your bees reminds me of my first big Cub Scout project.
We had to map out the local wildlife, and it taught me that every single creature has a totally unique role.
It's the exact same way with your bees!
If you pay close attention, you'll see that not all of them drop the same tokens.
Track down the specific bees in your hive that drop Blue and Red Boost Tokens, and bring a bunch of them back for my satchel.
going: Remember, not all bees drop the same tokens!
Come back when you're done, alright?
finish: Fantastic job! You figured out exactly which bees to watch and gathered my precious tokens!
Look at how vibrant these Boost Tokens are.
They'll look absolutely stunning next to my old scouting badges.

take: You're making incredible progress, rookie!
But things are about to get a little... explosive!
Back in my scouting days, when we were earning our Outdoor Safety badges.
We learned all about handling hazardous materials and staying out of harm's way.
I'm telling you this because I noticed some of your bees have started dropping Bomb Tokens!
They're incredibly powerful, and would look so cool in my satchel.
I want you to collect some for me, but please be careful.
Remember our motto: "Let your mark grow and prosper!" - Just try not to blow yourself up doing it!
going: Keep your distance when those fuses light, rookie!
I need those Tokens intact, and I need you in one piece!
finish: Whoa, you actually brought them back safely!
And there's not even one single scratch on you... how surprising.
Impressive job, rookie. Here's your well-deserved reward!

take: Alright, rookie, it's time to see if you can handle some real firepower.
Back when I was moving up to a Senior Scout, they didn't just teach us how to read maps.
They taught us how to clear dangerous paths using controlled blasts.
We had to handle some seriously volatile materials to clear blocked trails!
I want to see if you have that kind of steady hand.
You need to collect every single one of them without getting blown sky-high.
This is a high-risk haul for my satchel, so stay sharp.
going: Keep your distance and beware the blast radius!
Make sure you bring me those Tokens in one piece!
finish: Incredible! You still have all your limbs intact!
You handled that chaos like an absolute pro.
I started this mission to fill my satchel, but looking at you...
I realize I'm quite sad that we'll have to part ways so soon.
A-Anyway! Here's your reward!

take: Well, rookie... this is it. The moment of truth.
Look at my satchel!
It's already almost full.
This isn't just a test of skill anymore, it's your final exam.
So show me everything you've learned!
For the last time as my assistant, go out there and show the whole forest what you're made of!
going: This is the final stretch, rookie!
Make every single token count!
I’ll be right here, waiting to see history be made.
finish: ...It's beautiful. Look at that!
My satchel is finally full!
But honestly... looking at this full satchel doesn't even compare to how proud I am of you.
You handled every single challenge I threw at you without even breaking up a sweat...
*Sniff* *Sniff* Sorry, some pollen just landed into my eyes.
Here's my last reward for you.
Thank you for everything, rookie.
You really made your mark!
I hope we'll cross paths once again...
...Nah, I'm sure we will!

name: Druid Bear
description: Druid Bear watches over the Wheel, tasking players with deepening their bond to the Wisteria, Lotus, and Blossom Fields.

take: [You approach the strange looking bear]
[The bear notices you and shows a gentle smile]
[He gestures to himself, then to the vast fields, and taps his chest twice to show he is the guardian of this place]
[Out of nowhere, a glowing scroll appears in his hands, and he hands it to you]
[The scroll specifies that his name is "Silvane"]
[Followed by a list that requests "Pollen from the Wisteria, Lotus, and Blossom fields"]
going: [He nods at the list in your hand and gestures toward the fields]
finish: [He watches you return and looks at the gathered essence with a look of pure, silent wonder]
[He takes the pollen from you and hands you some honey, as well as something that looks like a vine]
[He points toward the vine, then to the forest and his heart]
[Meaning: "This vine is a piece of my home, and by extension, a piece of me."]
["I am entrusting it to you because I see your heart is in rhythm with the forest, just like mine."]

take: [Silvane approaches you with soft, rhythmic steps, the flowers on his antlers swaying in unison]
[He pulls out his magical scroll, gives it to you, and point out to the Blossom Field]
going: [He bows his head in respect and shows a gentle smile.]
finish: [He accepts the pollen, and as he touches it, a faint, sweet floral scent fills the air.]
[He then closes his eyes and proceeds to absorb the essence of the pollen]
[You come to a sudden realization]
"So that's why he needs pollen from the Ancient Fields..."
"The pollen is actually like food for him."
"It's what keeps him alive."

take: [Silvane greets you, but he doesn't look at the fields today]
[Instead, he looks at the surrounding plants, which are starting to wilt]
[He gestures to the Wisteria Field, indicating that its essence is needed to restore the land]
going: [He nods, and for the first time, he touches his forehead to yours. A silent, intense spark of gratitude.]
finish: [The moment he absorbs the essence, a pulse of pure, white energy ripples out from him, revitalizing the nearby plants.]
[You realize the truth]
"Silvane seems to depend on the pollen from the Ancient Fields."
"He extracts essence from the special pollen produced by them."
"And, in turn, he takes care of the forest."

take: [Silvane stands waiting, though he looks a bit thinner today, his glow flickering like a dying candle]
[He offers the scroll, his movements slower than before]
[He points to the Lotus Field, with a trembling claw]
going: [He presses a palm to his chest and then points to you, a gesture of silent urgency]
finish: [As he absorbs essence, the light in his eyes stabilizes and brightens significantly]
[He sighs. A sound like wind through leaves is heard]
[You watch him closely and think to yourself]
"He's recovering..."
"I wonder what happened for him to be so drained."

take: [Silvane looks weaker than ever, his glow barely visible in the dim light of the fields]
[He points to the Lotus Field, where a dangerous Butterfly made its lair, after which, he clutches his chest, wincing in pain]
[You gain a sense of deja vu when seeing the butterfly]
"Wait, that Butterfly looks familiar..."
[He hands you the scroll one last time, his hand shaking, pointing to the Butterfly that could be seen from a distance]
[He gestures for you to be careful, his eyes filled with a sad, silent plea]
going: [He places both hands on your shoulders and bows his head, as if giving you his blessing for the battle ahead]
finish: [As you return, Silvane’s form begins to glow with a brilliant, steady light for the first time]
[He stands tall, the flowers on his antlers blooming vibrantly.]
[You watch as he exhales a cloud of sparkling, healing mist that heals the damage done by the Butterfly]
[And, you've come to understand everything now]
"The Butterfly was draining the essence directly from the fields."
"He probably tried to defeat it alone, but ultimately lost."
"With that thing gone, and the pollen I gathered, he was finally able to regain his strength."
"So he can heal the forest properly now."
[Silvane approaches you, takes out a purple vine, and gently places it into your hands.]
[He nods, and for the first time, he touches his forehead to yours. A silent, and intense spark of gratitude]

name: Painter Bear
description: Painter Bear is an artistic bear who asks you to collect Sticker Tokens making her the most time consuming bear to complete.

take: Ohmygosh, are you the beekeeper I keep hearing about?
GASP YOU ARE!! OHMYGOSH HI! IT'S SO GOOD TO MEET YOU!
Ooh! You must be here for a quest, right?
I think I have just the thing for you to help me with... Hmmhm~!
So, as I walking through the fields for inspiration, I think I dropped some of my stickers without realizing!
If you don't mind, could you go look for them? I believe it was a shovel, a rake, a hammer, a magnet, and scissors.
OMG THANK UU! I'll be sure to give you peeeeelly something good!
*[SNICKERS-]* HAHAHA-! Get it?! Peely like a sticker!
Oh! I almost forgot! I'mmm Painter Bear! But you can also call me Canvy if you'd like!
Anyways, GO GO GO! YOU CAN DO IT!
going: *[You see her continuing to paint on her canvas, humming to herself.]*
*[You can't quite make out what she's trying to paint, but you figure it'll come together by the time you find those stickers.]*
finish: Hm...? Oh-! Did you do it!? YAA YIPPEE! Thanks a honey bunch, beekeeper!
And with that, consider your first quest and my painting complete! Hooray!
*[Painter Bear shows you her picture of a bee happily gathering pollen from some flowers.]*
*[You suddenly feel inspired.]*
How does it look? Feelin' pretty fuzzy, huh? Anyways, here's those rewards I promised!!
Be sure to come back again, I could always use some help with my next masterpiece~!

take: *[You find her yet again painting away at her cavnas, almost laser focused]*
*[Suddenly, she drops one of her paint brushes. As she goes to pick it up, she notices you standing there.]*
Oh, hi beekeeper! Good to see you again!!
Hmhmm, don't worry~! I didn't forget about our questss!
This time, I purposely dropped some stickers in the field for you to find!
Ready for a REAL Sticker Hunt!?
Just find these four stickers: A Daisy, a Clover, a Mushroom, and a Blackberry!
All found in their respected fields, created by me!!
Goodluck, beekeeper~!
going: Hmmm, now this'll go here... Mhmm!
*[She talks to herself as she blissfully continues her work with the brightest smile on her face.]*
*[Seeing her work brings you much joy, but also slight envy.]*
*[Best to start looking for those stickers now.]*
finish: Yipppeee, you found them all!! Must've been a haaard challenge, huh?
Hope you enjoy your prize, and a painting of mine too!!
*[The canvas is a mix of all four of the fields you collected the stickers from.]*
*[It's as if it's slightly abstract, but you can tell which is which from the unique shapes for each field.]]*
I wanted to go for the feeling of.. 'Closing your eyes and seeing weird shapes behind your eyelids' sorta thing!
Hmmh, isn't it neat~?
Anywho, I'll see ya around beekeeperrrr~

take: Hihi! Welcome back to the studio, friend!! Hmhmm~!
You did so well on your last quest, I decided to up the sakes a bit!
Time to dig for some more tool stickerss!!
Shouldn't be tooooo hard-! Just find an Axe, a Pickaxe, a Scythe! Aaanndd..
A Gold Magnet Sticker! Ooooooh, shiny.~
I recommend boosting your luck a little more before going out to find these ones-.
Don't worry, I can wait!!
going: By the way, have you been liking some of the new sticker eggs I made?
They're full of many sticker-y surprises!! Have ya gotten anything special yettt~?
finish: Wowie! That was a looot of searching, I hope it was fun!!
Hmm? Oh! My Painting! It's still a work in progress, sorry friend!
Been really busy makin' a bunch of stickers, so many that I think my sticker printer is gonna blow a fuse!
It's become a part of my hobby, hehe.~
Do you have any hobbies besides collectin' pollen, friend?
Maybe try gettin' out of your comfort zone and try something new! That's how I got into sticker making!
I'ma go finish up my painting now, it calls to me... Hmhmm, see ya around!

take: Yaaaay, back for more!! Safe to say, my sticker printer needs a break after this!
Don't worry, it's not broken-! Yet.. Hmmhm~!
This one'll be a doozy, so I hope you're REALLY print-pared! *[Snickers]*
So, what you need to find ISS:
*[INHALE-]*
A Red Flower, a BLUE Flower, a SUNflower, A BELLflower- (HOOH-! That's a lot of flowers!)
A Spider, and a Strawberry to top it all off!
Talk about a 'berry' on top!
You can do it beekeeper, I BEElieve in you! Heheh~!
going: *[You see what looks to be a Spider shape on her canvas, it looks a little scary...]*
*[You wonder if she'll make it look any cuter when she's done.]*
finish: Aaaannndd... DONE! Just on time, friend! Look look!!
*[The painting potrays a cute, chibi spider holding a bouquet a flowers, noming on a strawberry.]*
*[You sigh in relief as you feel more inspiration flowing within you.]*
How do ya like it, beekeeper~? Think it fits the quest well?
Thank you so much for helping me out with motivation, these sticker quests really got the juice outta me!
Feel free to come back to visit me for my next big painting~!

take: Time for another game of Find n' seek, beekeeper!
Hope you're excited, this ones gonna be EXTRA shiney!
As shiney as a diamond.~ Hmmhm!
A LOT of these stickers are rare, so rare- you'll need 10 lucky bees to help ya out!
You got a Bamboo sticker, a Banana, a Raspberry-
A Snowdrop one, a Pine Cone one- and a Rose!
Can YOU find all these stickers in time?! Clocks tickin' friend!
*[Chuckles]* Nono, friend! No timers for this one, pinkie promise~!
Black Bear always talks about patience, so be sure to have a lot for this one!
On your mark, get set! Aaannnnd... GO FIND EM!
going: *[You see her painting at her canvas, but this time turned away from you...]*
*[She's as extra focused as ever, so determed that you can feel it just from where you're standing.]*
*[You figure it's best you leave her be to go find those stickers she left you.]*
finish: *[You see her with her paws behind your back, a bit of what looks to be a canvas peaking out from behind her.]*
Hiii, beepeekerrrr~! Congrats on finding them all!
I've created something veeeerry special for you, ready to see it?!
Ready? One, twoo... aaaaannnddd- Tadaaa!
*[The painting she pulls from behind her brings a small tear to your eye...]*
*[It reveals a picture of you, some of your bees, and her all standing in an open field of flowers.]*
*[You all look so happy, collecting the pollen from the flowers around you while she throws what looks to be stickers into the air.]*
It's a painting dedicated to our friendship, and what it truly means to me...
Us all having fun in the fields, searching, collecting, creating...
These quests have helped me a lot with my recent art block, it's all been so... inspiring!
These small quests have meant the world to me, I hope you feel the same too, beekeeper!
I also, wanted to give you this... A Diamond Egg, just for you!
Thank you for the motivation boost, and for being a close friend...~
Feel free to come and visit me more often, I can even teach ya how to paint!
See ya sometime soon, beekeeper! Keep being inspired!!!

name: Panda Bear
description: Panda Bear tasks the player with defeating various mobs across the world.

take: Hmph. A new face.
Uhh... That thing you're holding...
...That's a rather interesting weapon choice.
Name's Panda Bear, but I prefer to be called Spear.
I'm keeping an eye on the perimeter right now.
My family legacy demands getting rid of any threat that disrupts the balance of this forest.
Right now, some slow crawlers are wandering into the Clover Field.
They don't look like much, but a protector doesn't hesitate.
Think you can defeat them?
Let's see if you can handle it.
going: ...You're still here?
Sigh. If you're afraid just say so.
I'm not gonna force you, you know?
finish: Done already? Hmm... Good job.
The Clover Field is secure for now, thank you.
Take this Honey and Bamboo. You've earned it, I suppose.
But don't let it get to your head, the forest always has more threats waiting.

take: Back for more, kid?
You've got guts, I'll give you that.
The scouts just reported more of those crawlers nearby.
My ancestors would have charged in without a second thought to crush every single one of them.
Let's head out there and defeat those bugs, this time I'm coming with you.
We'll see if the first time was just beginner's luck or you've actually got the skills.
going: Don't overthink it, just focus on your stance and keep your guard up.
Show me what you're made of!
finish: Hmph. You actually pulled it off.
...However, you showed mercy and they were able to get away.
They did look quite harmless, but....
No matter. A job is a job.

take: You're becoming a regular around here, kid.
The scouts are reporting that even more bugs started appearing.
More of those slow crawlers, and now a red, spotted one has joined them.
