Beware, unlike the ones you fought before, I hear that the red one is rather nimble.
I need you to head over there and handle them.
going: Keep your eyes sharp, kid.
Don't let them catch you off guard.
finish: Hmph. Clean work.
The forest is quiet again.
That red bug... it was just sitting on a leaf before we got there.
Didn't even try to attack first.
I wonder...
Nah, forget it. Good job today.

take: Things are stepping up, kid.
The scouts are reporting the appearance of a new bug.
It seems to have a hard shell, making it quite durable.
I remember seeing one that matches that description when I was barely a cub.
...When the war tore my homeland apart.
The smoke, the clashing of swords...
...And then being left all alone in these woods until my adoptive parents stumbled upon me.
I was terrified of the dark, but a kind old couple took me in and showed me salvation.
Even if they don't seem to pose much of a threat, I still have a duty to keep the fields clear.
Would you help me defeat a few of those spotted and hard-shelled bugs?
Don't worry, I've got your back in case anything happens.
going: In battle, you don't charge blindly at armor.
You find a gap and strike with precision.
That's how you achieve victory!
finish: Even though you weapon choice is quite peculiar...
And your way of dealing with the bugs is rather gentle.
I can see incredible talent blooming inside you, kid.
Keep it up and you might be able to surpass even me!

take: A massive swarm of bugs is gathering all at once.
Some of them even started fighting each other and creating territories.
Seeing this brings back bitter memories...
In my family... the strong makes the rules, and the others obey them.
Because I was adopted, my siblings antagonized me the most.
I tried both swords and bows, as per the family's tradition, but I had no talent for them.
However, the moment I picked up a spear, my talent was so overwhelming I rose to the top.
I can see your determination. It's not fueled by negative emotions...
... It's a pure desire to grow.
It's honestly a first seeing someone like you.
Alright, enough with the sentimentality.
Let's go and clear those bugs.
going: Don't let them surround you!
Focus on your stance and become one with your weapon!
finish: Incredible. You faced down an entire swarm and didn't even falter!
You really have a warrior's heart blooming inside you, kid.
Winning battles used to feel hollow to me, but watching you grow...
...It fills me up with strange emotions.
Anyway, I've prepared something a little special for you.
Here, I'm sure it will come in handy.

take: A massive group of the red, spotted ones appeared out of nowhere.
My family would tell me to wipe them out all alone without asking any questions.
*Small sigh* Honestly, I never liked their way of doing things.
...I remember the day I decided to pack my things and leave my family behind.
Right after I had a fight with my big brother... the one that left this chip in my ear.
I had proven my talent with the spear, but I realized I didn't want a life built on all trampling over the weak.
I chose to find my own path in life, even if it meant being alone.
I believe you are strong enough to defeat them on your own, but I will help you if needed.
Let's go. Show me how much you've improved your fighting skills.
going: Stay light on your feet, kid!
The spotted ones are nimble on their feet!
finish: Hmph. Clean and efficient, as always.
You didn't show any unnecessary malice out there, just pure focus.
Good job this time as well, you're making me proud.

take: A whole army of the hard-shelled ones have appeared.
They look intimidating, hiding behind all that heavy armor.
My family always told me that armor is for the weak.
But looking at them now... they're just trying to protect themselves.
Being a protector shouldn't involve killing unless it's an absolute necessity.
This is what it means to be a true protector.
Let's go out there and deal with them, kid.
Show them your strength, and never forget what you're fighting for.
going: Don't let their heavy shells intimidate you!
Find the gap in their defense and move with precision!
finish: Incredible work out there.
You managed to make them leave without any issue whatsoever.
My family would call me soft for thinking this way...
...But looking at you, I know for certain that there is another way.
You've taught me something truly important, and I'm really grateful for that.

take: The ground is shaking, kid.
The scouts say that a massive bug with eight legs has appeared out of nowhere.
It doesn't seem to be particularly aggressive, from their description.
Seems like it's just trying to protect its own territory.
Still, its presence is causing panic, so we have to step up.
Let's go face it together.”
going: Watch out for those webs, kid!
Try not to get stuck in them!
finish: We did it... it's retreating back into the shadows.
We proved our strength, and it seems to respect our boundaries now.
My family... they would never understand the kind of victory we achieved today.
I used to think I was completely alone after leaving my homeland behind.
But standing here with you and watching you grow...
...I know what path to choose now.
Thank you.

take: Just when I thought we could finally take a breather...
A massive wave of crawlers and more of those eight legs appeared all at once.
My family always told me a true warrior never complains about a never-ending fight.
Honestly? I used to hate that saying.
But with you, I actually feel ready for whatever comes next.
Let's go out there and show them what a real duo can do.
going: Watch your step out there!
I've got your back!
finish: Man, we really did a good job.
Every time we fight together, our coordination just gets better.
It seems like... It's not just you that is growing.

take: This is it, kid. The ultimate test of strength just appeared.
The entire forest is buzzing, and every single creature we've faced is swarming the fields all at once.
It's looking like a full on war out there!
However, we're facing this together, as partners.
Let's go, we've got this.
going: Focus, kid!
They're coming from all sides!
finish: We did it... Peace at last.
We actually managed to protect the forest without spilling any blood.
I left my homeland looking for purpose, thinking my spear was only meant for fighting.
But you showed me it's meant for protecting the things and people that matter.
I couldn't have asked for a better partner, or a better friend.
...Huh? You... have to leave?
Oh... I understand. I can see the ambition in your eyes.
I wouldn't want to limit your potential by keeping you in one place.
I know your future will be bright.
...Just make sure you visit me from time to time, alright?
Until then, here's my final parting gift.
Farewell... partner.

name: Polar Bear
description: Polar Bear is located at the 15 Bee Zone near the Blue Shop, he tasks the player with collecting a bunch of pollen. He is the first bear to give a Diamond Egg as a reward.

take: *Screams*
S-Sorry, I didn't hear you walk up to me.
I was just... enjoying the warmth and reading a b-book, so I didn't notice you at first and got scared.
I'm Polar Bear, b-but most people call me Snowflake.
Y-You want a task? Oh, goodness... I don't want to b-bother you or take up your time...
Are you s-sure I'm not being a nuisance?
Well... alright, if it's not too much trouble...
C-Could you help me gather some pollen?
I always n-need pollen of all kinds.
A-And I especially need some from the Mushroom Field right now.
T-Thank you for the helping hand...
going: T-Take your time out there...
There's no rush at all!
finish: You're already back? W-Wow... You are so fast.
L-Look at all this beautiful pollen... My Snowdrops are going to love this!
Oh, I g-guess you wouldn't know, b-but my Snowdrops are a little unique.
Because of a little m-mutation, they are able to get nutrients from pollen!
Thank you for helping me t-today.
H-Here is your reward...

take: H-Hello again! I-I was just watering the Snowdrops.
Back in my old homeland, there weren't many bright colors.
Everything was just... beautiful, endless white snow and ice.
B-But here? The colors are so incredibly vibrant!
I'm still trying to get used to how warm it is, b-but I really love the change.
If you have some spare time, c-could you gather some pollen from the Clover Field for me?
I-I promise I won't keep you long...
going: The sun is quite warm t-today...
P-Please don't overexert yourself out in the fields!
finish: Oh, my! You gathered all of this from the Clover Field?
Back home, there were very few f-flowers because of the harsh weather.
T-Thank you for the help!

take: Um... can I ask you a question?
D-Do you think my sweater looks okay?
Back where I'm from, everyone wore incredibly heavy, t-thick fur coats just to survive the blizzards.
If you didn't, y-you'd freeze in minutes!
When I arrived here, I knitted this lighter sweater so I could... f-fit in with the forest style and stay comfortable in the heat.
B-But I still worry that it looks a bit silly...
Oh, you like it? T-Thank you...
Well... Since you're so kind, could you help me with another Clover Field run?
going: I-I'm just sitting here in my rocking chair if you need me...
Don't worry, I'm just reading a book to pass the time.
finish: Wow, spectacular j-job!
D-Did you know? Clover honey is one of the world’s m-most popular honeys.
Bees v-visiting the Clover Field make a mild, sweet honey that’s loved everywhere.

take: U-Um... hello again!
I-I was actually hoping you'd stop by.
I think I forgot to m-mention this before, but I'm the one that planted the Snowdrops here.
Since you're so good at gathering, c-could you help me tend to them and get some of their pollen?
I-I want to make sure they are adjusting well to the forest soil...
going: I-If you get cold near the Snowdrops, you can come sit by my cabin!
I always give friends a w-warm welcome!
finish: Y-You're back! And you didn't freeze at all!
Did you know t-that Snowdrops are incredibly tough?
They actually contain their own built-in n-natural "antifreeze" proteins!
I-It prevents the ice from destroying their cells so they can pierce right through s-solid snow blankets.
Seeing them bloom here m-makes me feel like... well, like there's always hope, even after a b-brutal winter.
T-Thank you for helping me and my Snowdrops adjust to life here!

take: O-Oh! Welcome back!
I-I was just sitting here in my rocking chair, watching the clouds pass over the cabin.
It's so peaceful today...
If it's not too much trouble... c-could you head over to the Clover Field again and gather more pollen for me?
going: Take your time, I'm n-not in a hurry.
I-I'll just be right here reading my book if you need me.
finish: O-Oh! Look at all that pollen!
Huh? W-What is that?
A-A four-leaf clover?
It's.. still all together too!
N-Normally they break apart and wilt when they're taken away from the Clover Field f-for too long.
I've heard, that's a really big sign of g-good luck! Good job!
W-Wait... You want to give it to me?
B-But I couldn't...
Alright, if y-you insist... T-Thank you so much!

take: Where I grew up, t-the sun only rises and sets once a year because of the Earth's tilt.
T-That means we had six whole months of total daylight, followed by s-six straight months of pitch blackness!
Tropical fruit like bananas felt like a myth to me.
C-Could you head over to the Banana Field and gather some pollen for me?
I-I want to study how the sweet scent compares to my Snowdrops!
going: B-Bananas are shaped like little yellow smiles, aren't they?
I think that's why they give off such good vibes...
finish: Y-You did it! And look at how golden this pollen is...
During those six months of total darkness back home, we used to look up at the Northern Lights to keep our spirits up.
But honestly? The bright colors of these fruits bring me just as much joy.
T-Thank you for always helping me out!
I-I'll be right here in my rocking chair if you want to chat again later!

take: H-Hello again! I hope your day is going well.
Growing s-sweet, juicy berries in that f-freezing darkness was completely impossible in my homeland.
Getting to see them g-grow abundantly here feels like a dream.
C-Could you head over to the Raspberry Field and gather some pollen for me?
going: Please d-don't rush...
T-The berries aren't going anywhere, and the sun is lovely today.
finish: Y-You're back! Oh my, look at how bright red this pollen is!
D-Did you know? A raspberry isn’t j-just one fruit.
It’s many tiny fruits called drupelets, each w-with its own seed!
It's h-honestly fascinating.
T-Thank you for helping me out. It means a lot to have your company.

take: I've been spending a lot of time sitting in my rocking chair, just looking out at the Pine Cone Field.
Back in the North Pole, t-there are no trees at all because the deep soil stays f-frozen solid all year round.
It's something called p-permafrost.
T-The roots simply can't pierce the ice!
Seeing these m-massive pine trees with their beautiful wooden p-pine cones is incredibly fascinating to me.
If you aren't too busy... c-could you gather some pollen from the Pine Cone Field for me?
going: I love the sound of the wind rustling through the pine needles...
I-It's so much gentler than an arctic gale.
finish: O-Oh, spectacular job!
This pollen smells s-so crisp and fresh.
It reminds me a t-tiny bit of the clean, biting winter air from home
J-Just without the f-freezing shivers!
I used to worry that leaving t-the cold North Pole would make me homesick.
B-but people like you make this warm forest feel like exactly where I b-belong.

take: I... um... have a bit of an emergency in the S-Snowdrops Field.
Since the N-North Pole has absolutely no land or soil, f-flowers don't usually grow there.
However, d-due to their unique adaptation to the climate, Snowdrops can actually g-grow on ice!
Snowdrops can also generate heat b-because of a phenomenon called t-thermogenesis.
It’s not as w-warm as fire, but it’s enough to m-melt the snow!
S-So, because of that and the naturally warm t-temperature of this region, the Snowdrops Field is at risk of catching f-fire!
Please help me collect some p-pollen from them! This will help r-regulate the heat in the field.
going: P-Please be careful out there...
The Snowdrops Field is extremely hot r-right now.
finish: Thank you! I h-hope it wasn't too much trouble!
W-Wanna know another fun fact about Snowdrops?
The heat also h-helps disperse the scent more effectively on cold days, improving their chances of being pollinated!

take: H-Hello again!
I... um... have a bit of a secret project I'm working on in my cabin.
Since moving to this warm forest, I-I've noticed that everything has such a distinct, lovely scent.
Back at the North Pole, the air is s-so freezing cold that it completely freezes odors!
Berry requested a s-special perfume for Delilah, because their 45th aniversary is coming up in a few days.
I h-hear that roses are very popular, so I was t-thinking of adding them to her perfume!
C-Could you help me gather some pollen from the Rose Field?
I need some to make the f-foundation of the perfume.
going: P-Please watch out for the thorns out there!
I don't want you g-getting hurt while gathering ingredients for my p-perfume...
finish: O-Oh my goodness, you're back! And t-this crimson pollen is so incredibly fragrant!
Alright, the f-first ingredient is ready, I just need t-the rest now.
B-By the way, here are some t-treats for your bees.
I hope t-they find them tasty!

take: W-Welcome back!
I was j-just... um... looking at the Bamboo Field over t-there.
It blows my m-mind how tall those stalks grow!
Y-You see, since, back in the North Pole there's no land or soil,
Plants like b-bamboo aren't even able to take root, let alone grow
So t-there's just, none at all! T-The land is just a massive, s-shifting sheet of sea ice floating on top of the deep ocean.
And, I want to incorporate some p-pollen from that Bamboo into Delilah's perfume.
It will give the perfume a c-cool, airy freshness that keeps the roses from feeling too h-heavy!
If it's not too much trouble... c-could you gather some pollen from the Bamboo Field?
going: The breeze through that bamboo sounds a bit like a b-blizzard...
B-But a much warmer, nicer one.
finish: W-Wow, look at all of this! You're amazing.
Did you know that b-because the North Pole is just floating ice, the magnetic p-pole actually migrates and moves a few miles every single year?
It's never in the same p-place!
I guess... I'm a bit l-like the magnetic pole.
I m-migrated all the way here to find my own right spot.
And... I'm r-really glad this spot has you in it.

take: H-Hi! Welcome back!
Do you want to hear a f-fun fact about bananas?
B-Botanically speaking, bananas qualify as t-true berries, while strawberries don't.
Coincidentally, I h-heard that banana scents are becoming a t-trend as of late.
C-Could you head over to the Banana Field and g-gather some for me?
going: As m-much as I like you helping me...
...Please m-make sure to take a break from time to time, alright?
I w-wouldn't want you to get burnt out.
finish: Look at h-how golden this pollen is!
T-That sweet smell... It's so... addictive.
P-Please, come back whenever you can, I need just a f-few more ingredients!

take: U-Um... excuse me... can I ask for your help with the next ingredient?
The perfume smells wonderful, b-but the sweet fruits and florals evaporate too quickly.
It needs something to t-tie it all down.
If we add crisp p-pine pollen, it will act as a wooden anchor, keeping the p-perfume smelling fresh on the skin for hours.
S-So could you gather some pollen from the Pine Cone Field?
going: We're almost done!
J-Just a little more!
finish: O-Oh, spectacular job!
F-Fun fact time!
Fossils show that pine cones existed over 140 m-million years ago, making them even older t-than flowers!
Because t-they react to humidity, p-people used them to predict the weather.
If t-the pine cones were open, it meant dry w-weather, if they were closed, it meant t-that rain was coming.
Alright, enough with the f-fun facts.
The w-woody base should tie the rose and banana together b-beautifully now.
J-Just one final touch to go!

take: H-Hi! I'm sorry to ask this of you so s-suddenly, but Berry told me that he needs the perfume t-till tomorrow.
So I'm in a h-hurry to finish the perfume!
I want to add a secret signature touch from my own garden... some pollen from the Snowdrops Field!
Delilah is at an age where she gets cold very easily, even though she likes cold tea.
So, with the special properties t-that Snowdrops have, it will help her stay w-warm while drinking what she loves!
C-Could you help me gather the pollen from the Snowdrops Field?
going: M-Make sure to watch your step out there...
The Snowdrops Field can get a little slippery if you aren't careful.
finish: W-Wow, look at that! The final ingredient that I needed!
Sorry, I don't have too much time on my hands, so I have to rush inside and create the perfume.
Thank you a lot for your help!
I'll make sure to t-tell you about her reaction when I f-find out about it from Berry.

take: Hi! You're back! Wonderful timing!
Okay, so... Delilah was absolutely overjoyed by our gift!
Berry said t-that she was on the verge of tears from happiness!
I'm truly grateful for your help. I-I couldn't have done it without you.
H-However, the work isn't quite finished!
I... um... have another small project I'm working on right now!
So, can you please go back to the Rose Field and bring me some pollen?
going: T-Take your time in the fields...
There's no rush, I-I'm not in a hurry.
finish: G-Good job! Wow, you gathered all of that so quickly...
I have prepared something for all of your hard work.
Go ahead and take it!
I'm sure you'll find a good use for it.
Don't worry, I still have one more mission for you before we are done.
Come back to me whenever you feel ready!

take: N-Nice to see you again, my friend!
I have just one s-small, final task for you.
I p-promise it is worth your time! *wink*
going: N-No need to rush!
No, actually, m-move as slowly as you can!
finish: Just as f-fast as I remembered...
I'm s-sorry to give you such a t-tedious and weird task.
The t-thing is, I spoke with Canvy to create a special g-gift just for you!
B-But it wasn't ready yet, so I h-had to distract you until then.
Luckily, Canvy arrived with it r-right before you came back.
Here is my f-final reward for your help!
H-Hope you enjoy it! *Smiles*
It was r-really nice meeting you!
T-Take good care of yourself out there! *Waving Hand*

name: Sandy Bear
description: Sandy Bear is a laid-back bear found near the beach, offering quests centered around the coastal fields.

take: Yooo, a beekepeer! Welcome to the Summerfest event, lil' dude!
Name's Sandy Bear, but you can call me Grain. I'll be your host for this wave-tastic event!
I got some quests for ya that'll be sure to keep ya active and on your toes!
If you complete all 20 of my exciting quests, you will be rewarded with our limited graaaand prize!
What is it, you ask? Haha, I ain't tellin' ya that easily! You need to get started!
For your first quest, we'll start off niiice n' simple.
Go to the Shell Field near here and collect 2,500 of its pollen, then come right back here for your first prize!
Be sure to watch your step! Don't wanna break any shells while you're there.
Ready, set... BEGIN!
going: I don't see that bag full yet, my dude! Keep on collecting!
finish: Hahaaa, there ya go! Now that's a full bag!
Congratulations on completing your first ever "SummerQuest!"
Here's a little somethin' special on the house, I made it myself!
Soon, I'll be teachin' ya to make your own just like this! Won't that be sweet?
Keep it cool, beezy dude! I'll see ya for the next quest!

take: Ahhh.. Such a relaxing day today, huh lil' buddy?
Let that fresh, crisp summer air brush up against you...
Get your feet wet from those cooool waves... Enjoy your time in the sun!
Haha, don't get too distracted though. It's time for your next quest!
How's about a little bit of coco? Get 10,000 Pollen out of the Coconut Field, then bring it all right back here.
Don't let 'em fall on your head like one of those cartoons though, haha!
going: Go on, lil' bro! You got this!
A little coco goes a loooooong way.
finish: *[She casually cracks open a coconut against the bridge side, and drinks the bit of fresh juice inside it]*
Ahh... Sweet, succulent success! Congrats again, dude!
You can continue to enjoy your time at the beach, here's some sweet refreshments to keep you cool!
Coconuts aren't the only thing I specialize in, I got some tangy lemonade drinks for ya as well!
Of course, those won't be 'til later, after some more quests!
For now, jus' go have fun out there, lil' bro! See ya around.

take: Hmmhm, what a time to be alive! Ready for your next quest?
How's about something a little more "zesty", ey?
*Does a little jiggy* Fresh from the juice, fresh from the juice! Your next stop is the Lemon Field!
Just collect 50,000 of that zesty, sour pollen, and give them lemons a gooood squeeze!
Whas that? "A bit of a step up from the last?" Aaawww don't worry about it my friend! It's nothin' you can't handle!
Squeeeeze all those sour stresses out of yourself and get to collecting! Go go go!
going: That pollen can't pollenate itself, y'know? Haha!
finish: Hoooweee! That's the spirit, lil' dude! Awesome work!!
You are one fiesty lil' beekeeper, I like it!
Here's some of that syrupy goodness I promised ya, make sure not to get it on your shoese!
You really showed that field you're no sour-puss, haha! Keep up the wave-tastic work!

take: Gettin' hyped up from the quests yet? Feelin' the urge within ya to continue?
Good, good! That's the spirit! We need more of that, cuz we still got a waaaaves to go!
It's time to fill up that bag with some rainbow power!!
Go back to the fields, and get 150,000 of ALL pollen colors!
How's THAT for a big jump?
You got this, lil' buddy. Don't stop now!
going: *Chants* C'mon beekeeper, you can do it! C'mon beekeeper, don't stop yet!
Ain't no beekeeper quite like you, so c'mon beekeeper, it's Summerfest!!~
finish: There's my shimmering cloud! I can see those beeeeautiful color rays of pollen bouncing right off ya!
Wipe that sweat off ya forehead and enjoy some special cocktail to cool ya down, you deserve it!
It's my most special cocktail of all, the Summer Cocktail! Every bear who comes always asks for this foamy-cold delight.
My tiki bar will sometimes have LINES of 'em, just to try this one drink!
And just for you, I'll share how you can make one of your own.
Cheers to you, lil' buddy! Keep it cool.

take: Allllrighty, beekeeper! Ready for a true, coco-crazed challenge??
I sure hope you are, 'cos you got a TON of pollen to collect!
Go collect 50 coconuts for the stash, AND ONE. MILLIONNNNN COCO POLLEN!
You thought the last quest was a lot? Well that's 'cos it was! Hahaha!
But don't sweat it, pal! I can tell you've got the guts to do it!
You'll be paid VERY handsomely for this quest, I promise! You'll feel like a true LEGEND when you're done!
Now buzzzz to it, buddy!
going: Give those palm trees a good shakin', you'll get them coconuts eventually!
Just be sure to keep your head up, don't let 'em bump ya in the head like in those cartoons!
Huh? I told you that already?
Oh well my bad then, go ahead n' get hit then! Hahaha!
finish: Aaannd just like that, our marvoulous beekeeper completed collecting ONE. MILLION. COCO POLLEN!
As well as 50 whole fresh coconuts! Perfect for more succulent cocktails!
What a feat, what a goal! I told ya you could do it!
Such work deserves a legendary reward, don't cha think?

take: Saayy, does it smell a little fishy in here? Or is it just the water next to me?
Haha, anywho! Time for your next quest! I smell another citrus-y one comin'.
Yess, this will be a step up from the last.
TWO MILLION, FIIIIVE HUNDRED THOUSAND LEMON POLLEN!
If you're a Blue Hive, this should be smooooth sailing.~ If not, I suggest switchin' to one!
*Whispers* Don't forget to net your existing beeees!! Don't wanna lose 'em, do ya?
And uh, while you're at it, could ya get me 50 of those fresh lemons maybe? I'm runnin' all out!
Go get 'em, tiger!! Or should I say, tiger SHARK! Haha!
going: Lookin' at them numbers, you'd think "wowie, this is a lot of pollen!"
And you'd be right! It sure is!
But just wait till you get to the other quests...
Now THAT will be a lot of pollen!
finish: Hohooh, a quest so citrus-y I can feel it gettin' in my eyes! Wooh!
Aahah-ow-! Aaow no that's, real citrus. Real citrus in my eyes, agh!
*[She rubs her eyes with a joyful laugh.]*
Eheh, thank ya kindly for the lemon bag! More lemonade for everyone!!!
As promised, here is your crisp reward!
One Miiillllion honey, a Sweet, Summer Cocktail, and... the rarest, most refreshing of all..
A MAJESTIC COCKTAAAAAIL!!
You deserve it, king. You'll need it for the rest of your quests!
Keep havin' fun in the sun! I'll see ya for the next exciting quest in juuuust a moment, I got s'more drinks to make!

take: Yo yo, there's our favorite little beekeeper! How's the heat holdin' up, eyy?
I think it's time we mix some things up. Quite literally, aha!
For today's quest, we're mixing up a special sweet n' sour blend!
It's time YOU learn how to make the wonderful drinks I've been giving you yourself!
See my little stand here? There's a blender right inside, it's what I use to make all my drinks.
You can use it to craft your own cocktails, even the special summer one!
The ingredients are written down next to the blender, *Whispers* but don't share 'em with anyone else, ka-peesh?
For now, I'm tasking you to make 3 of each drink, Coconut AND Lemonade.
Bring 'em here and I can mix them together to make a delicious Tropical Blend!
If it passes a taste tast from me, you'll get your prize. Now shuffle on to it!!
going: Don't be shyyy, it's easy!
Just put them suckers in the blender, then mix-mix-mix it till ya get somethin' new! You can do it!
finish: AAlllright, beekeeperrr! Let's taste that drink!...
*[She mixes up a small cup of tropical blend and swirls it around in her paw, then puts it up to her mouth and takes a small sip.]
mmmMMmmHMhMmHmHMM!! *[She goes in for another sip, which turns into a large gulp]*
*Gulp, gulp, gulp...*
*[She takes one last gulp, downing the entire drink]*
I tell ya, if you were to tell me I made that, I'd believe it! Hahaha!! You're a natural!
Now that's what I call "a taste of the tropics!" THAT deserves a grand prize as is!
A ticket prize, of course! Hahah, thought I was gonna give the big one away, didn't cha? Not yet friend!
Still, AMAZING job on the drink. Remind me to ask you again some time for one of those!

take: Hey hey hey! Tiiime for some more drink makin'! You did so well on the last one, I got nooo doubt you can get this one done!
This time it won't be for me though, it'll be for YOU!
You'll be learnin' how to make the most tastiest cocktail of em all..
My very own Summer Cocktail!!!
You got the ingredients, the list is all there. But getting them is nooo easy task!
If you can manage to recreate this succulent drink, you'll be set for the whole Summerfest!
Get to mixin' friend!
going: Fiesta, FIESTA! Life's a party, lil' dude!
Don't stress it, you'll be able to perfect my cocktail in no time flat!
finish: *[Takes one small sip of your Summer Cocktail, just to compare]*
Ahh.. Perfect.~ Just like how I'd make it!
Add a little flower on top, aaaand... there ya go! All yours, my dude!
You deserve it all for such a journey like that, you must feel like a Honey-Filled Millionare!
Hang in the tide, ya still got lots to do!

take: Hope you're used to the blender now, got some more drink orders for ya to fill for your next quest!
First up, 3 Watery-Sweet Coconut Drinks.
Neeeeext up, 3 Zangy Lemonades.
Annnd finally, the all-time famous Summer Cocktail!
You got this in the bag, soon you'll be a master barista just like me!
What? You want a pay for working for me?
I thought that's what all those rewards were for! Haha!
going: The guests are gettin' thirsty for more! Don't meean to rush, but pick up that pace!
I'll hold 'em off as best as I can!!
finish: Here they are, everyone! Our upcoming barista!
Wave-tastic work out there, dude! Keep on rockin'!
Here's the pay you asked for, and, thanks for all that work by the way lil' dude. You're a great help.
See ya in a bit for the next quest!

take: Hoooww exciting! We're at the half-way point, man! Way to go!
Let's take a sec to relax, and chug down some sweet juice of the coconut!!
Thaaaat's right, it's a chugging challenge!!
If you can chug down 3 Coconut Drinks in one full go, I'll give ya a fabulous prize!
That being more Honey, and some drink compensation.
...Why are ya lookin' at me like that? I'm serious! This is the quest!
Chug! Chug! Chug! Chug! Chug!
going: Careful not to choke there, pal! They are delicious, but I don't want ya passin' out!
finish: Yeeeaaaah duuude!!
All 3 Coco-Drinks, completely gone! What a champ!!
Round of applause for our wonderfully talented beekeeper for making it this far!
*Canned Clapping Track*
Alright, alright, settle down folks! We still got another 10 to go!
These next quests will surely BITE ya in your rear!
But you've been unphased so far, surely you won't even notice!
Just gotta do everything you've done so far one more time! Hahaha!

take: Y'know what? I really liked that last chugging quest.
Let's do another!
I think some niiiice freshly squeezed lemonade would be perfect to try! Let it jus' floooowww down your gullet!
Just 3 cups of puuure sour lemon juice, sounds nice doesn't it?
Hahaha your face! Aaww don't worry about it! Don't let the sourness get to your head!
going: Maaan, don't be so sour about it! Haha!
If you REALLY want some sourness to your diet, I recommend a paws full of pure lemon candy.
Now THAT will really wrinkle your face up!
finish: Wooohoo!! That's the sunny spirit! Doesn't that lemonade make you feel so refreshed?
*Snicker* Ahaha-! Sorry sorry, I couldn't help it. Your sour face is just sooo-, here, let me show you.
*[She grabs a big cup of lemondae from nearby and chugs it all in one gulp]*
*[Her face scrunches up into an even worse sour expression than yours]*
Ooooohoho man!! Yeah that is NOT as easy as you made it look!
Aaah, it's always a fun time here during Summerfest! I dunno about you, but I'm havin' the time of my life!
Brings a smile to my face seein' so much joy here.~ Surely you must be feelin' it!
Anywhosit, here's your reward! Come back for more later on!

take: Alright, alright, let's relax witht he chugging games now.
You've been puttin' in a lot of work making all those drinks.
I think you deserve a VIP pass to my next private beach party for that!
To celebrate and jus', relax from everything, let's have some Summer Cocktails, ehh?
Not just one, but TWO cocktails must be consumed at ONCE to complete this challenge!
Ready to taste the truuue feeling of summer? Go on, see what the hype's about!
going: *[You see her serving out drinks to other nearby bears, as well as consuming one herself]*
*[You feel as if you can watch her mix drinks all day, but decide its time to join in on the fun]*
finish: *Clinks your glass* Cheers to Summerfest my dude!
Now, was that a refresher or what?? Feels as if you're tasting the very waves surfers look out for...
...But less salty, obviously. Hahaha!

take: The stars are alligning for this sparkly night quest... Ready for your next *real* quest, lil' dude?
Y'see, when you specialize so much in fruit and food like I do, you naturally pick a lot of different skills.
So, surprise! I'm a bit of a chef, too! And I got a special order for a late night salad.
You're familiar with the Starflowers, how they always grow during the lunar night sky, hm?
Did you know, that you can grow your own, any time of day, anywhere ya'd like??
Yeeeaaah, sounds awesome right??
You can craft the seeds yourself back in the forest! Here is what YOU will be retrieving...
5 Basics, 2 Rare, and 1 Epic Starflower, as well as 100 of both Coconuts and Lemons.
Got it all written down? then gooooo get 'em!
going: It's a lot to collect, I know, but imagine the payoff!
Such magical and beautiful flowers. It'll be worth everything to see what they're capable of.
finish: WHooh! Abbsoolutely beeeautiful, dude! Look at those sparkles, like mini stars on those their petals!
Thanks so much for this, just in time too! The guests were getting a little bit rowdy.
And by that I mean the.. one guy, bein' a bit of a heckler, haha! Nothin' to worry about!
Here's your reward for such a task, couldn't get through this order without ya!
Keep frolickin' through them flowers, bro! Keep ooon collectin'!

take: Boy oh BOY do I got some tasks for you, dude! Time for some Vitamin "M!"
This quest requires quite a lot of Moon Charms, so look out for those lunar starflowers!
You'll be needing to make AND use 3 Moon Extracts, as well as craft n' drink up a Majestic Cocktail.
Aaand for a little extra on the side, grab up 100 Strawberries, Blueberries, and Pine Cones!
Hup to it, the night don't last forever unless ya make it!!
What does that mean? Don't think about it too hard! Jus' go!
going: I can see those shimmers in the horizon... Those starflowers must be comin' up soon!
Keep an eye out for 'em! I sense the night shall be here soon...
finish: Way to go, beekeeper! That's how ya keep the night alive!
Man, is it just me, or are you glowin' a little? Hahahaa!
Here's your prize as promised, take a break and come back whenever you're all rested.

take: Alllright! Who's ready for some more pollen collecting?!
*Canned Cheering Track*
I can't heeear youuuu!~ I said.. WHO'S READY FOR MORE POLLEN COLLECTING?!
*Even LOUDER Cheering*
*Record Scratch*
Okay, okay.. All seriousness though, it's time to go back to the classics!
This is a *huge* task. Better prepare those bees!
You'll be taking on all three of the Summerfest fields, collecting ONE HUNDRED MILLION POLLEN from EACH FIELD!!
Told ya this was huge! Think ya finally got what it takes?
I'll be waitin' here, watchin from a far. Waiting in apsolute an-.. -tici-....
..-pation!
I believe you can do all this, and more! ESPECIALLY for what's comin up...
Good luck, you'll need every ounce of it!!
going: Oh yea, this is aaabbsolutely exciting stuff!! Ya taking any breathers from all that, man?
You really should, it's a lot to handle, I know!
Just considering how far you've come, I know it ain't nothin that's gonna stop you for long.
Go beekeeper, go!!
finish: *Blows loudly into her whistle* And that's a WRAP! Holy lemonzest, what a show you put on out there!
Pat yourself on the back with that one, beekeeper! That takes a LOT of effort and strength!
And with that, I've only got FIVE whole quests for you left to complete...
You heard me, FIVE. Look at how far you've come my dude!
Take a looong needed break if you're tired at all. Or, if you're ready... I can get you right onto the next quest!
Along with your prize comes a special gift from Canvy!
She wanted me to give you this sticker as a part of today's prize. Such a cute lil' seal!
See ya in a while, croc-o-dile!

take: And there they are, back and hungry for more already! Don't ya ever take breaks? Hahaaha!
Talk about a honey-ran pollen-collectin' master machine! Whoh!
Alright roboto, how's about an even harder challenge than the last?
Same thing as the last one, except... I'm adding onto the amount 5 times fold!
FIVE, HUNDRED, MILLION Pollen, in EACH and EVERY field!
...As well as crafting 5 Lemonades and Coconut Drinks!
That makes it simple, right?? Hahahaaa!
Let's not waste anymore time, get to it!!
going: Look at ya, you look like you're gonna faint!!
Don't neglect your own needs, dude! If you need a minute, you have time to rest at the shores.
finish: Annnnnd touchdown! So. Much. POLLEN!!
Take in that feeling of victory, dude, ya earned it!
We ain't done yet, though! 4 more quests, and you'll be homefree...
I promise you, the last reward is ABSOLUTELY worth the work!

take: I hope you still have enough strength for this next quest, bro! We're gonna be crackin' open s'more coconuts!!
And boy will there be a lot of em, you'll go NUTS over this!
For this coconut-packed quest, my friend... You got a lot more collectin' to do...
I'm talking in the BILLIONS, FIVE BIIILION POLLEN from those Coco-Fields to be exact!
PLUS 250 Coconuts, AAAND making and drinking 15 Coconut Drinks!
It's a real, true coco-craze! More than ever before!
Get out there and get loco for some coco!!!
going: The milk from a coconut is the most refreshingly tropical drink out there...
You'll be tasting a whole ton of it in a moment! Haha!
finish: Yeaahahaah!!! Totally UNREAL, dude!
This is the kind of reward many beekeepers strive for... And you did it all! What an amazing thing to be proud of.
It only gets more radical from here, beekeeper! There's SO much more to do!
Keep on pushing your limits, you're sooo close to the goal!!

take: Off from the coconuts, onto the lemons! It's time for your tastebuds to dive back into that tangy, soury field!
Just like the last, you'll be collecting Five BILLION Lemon Field Pollen.
As well as collectin' 250 zesty lemons, and making 15 cups of that sweet, sweet lemonade...~
Can't forget to drink every last cup, too! You'll be needing em for the amount of work you'll be doing!
I bet you've drank so much lemonade by now that you're practically immune to sourness now! Hahahaa!
Squeeeze your way to victory, show those lemons who's boss of those fields!!
going: Y'know, if the sourness is still too much for ya, don't forget to drink a ton of water!
Keeping yourself properly hydrated is important as a beekeeper! Same goes for those bees of yours, they need some drops too!
Unless you're an all-natural water bee, of course. *Wink* Hahahaa!
finish: Now THAT is some z-z-zest!! HOH! Really packed a PUNCH with that one!
Really ZAPPED the power outta ya! Put you to the ZEST! Eh? Ehh?
*Crickets*...
Alright, alright- I'll stop.
Those crickets have got some funny timing.
Hehe anyways-, it's time for another prize for our prized beekeeper.
Just a little more to go! Keep at it, lil' buddy.

take: WEEWOOWEEWOOWEEWOO! This just in, the moon is covering the sun!!
Is that a solar eclipse I'm seein'???
Ah, haha no- false alarm, folks! It's just our little beekeeper, shinin' brighter than usual!
Ready for the lightning before the storm? Cuz this one will make you as dizzy as being in the middle of a hurricane!
We're doubling the stakes, uping the counter by two... Turning this simple five, into a TEN!
TWICE!
We're talkin' TEN BILLION POLLEN, in both Coconut AND Lemon Field!!
And as usual, you know we gotta add some more drink makin' too! 25 Coco-drinks, and 25 cups of Lemonade!
Y'know what that means too, right?? MORE Tropical Blends!
Not a moment to waste, bro! GO GET THAT BAG!
going: We're gonna be drinkin' aaaaaaalllll night with that amount of lemons and cocos, buddy!
I've been missin' more of that Tropical Blend ya made... What was it that made it so special last time?
Not even I have been able to CRACK the code, haha!
finish: HOOOOWEE! Way to frickin' go, my man!! Cheers, cheers!
The amount of bears that'd love to have all that honey it'd convert too-, you'll be havin' em at your feet begging for more!
Haha, ahh, but we don't need it here when we already got so many drinks!
You're one quest away from the grand prize now, buddy... Go rest up, pal.
You'll need aaaaalll the preperation you can get!

take: Ladies and Gentlebears, this is it...
We've reach the final stretch of the Summerfest event, the moment we've all been waiting for...
Our little beekeeper as built up for this very occasion... Do you believe in em' folks?
I'm sure do. I believed you could due this since the very first quest.
Back when you only needed to collect 2,500 Pollen from one little field.
For your grand final quest; in every single summer field, you must achieve in collecting an amount...
SEVEN orders of magnitude greater!!
If I could get a drumroll, please...
*Suspenseful Drumroll*
TWWWEEENTTY. FIIVE. BIIILLLLIIIONN POLLEN!!
This is your BIGGEST, BRIGHTEST, most CHALLENGING task yet...
As well as making and consuming TWO Majestic Cocktails... AND, collecting 500 Coconuts and Lemons...
Do you think it got what it takes to beat the grandest finale yet, the "Sovereign of the Sea???"
Then go out there and prove your worth... Show us all your true, bee-loving power!
Make a girl proud, kid...
going: There's somethin' waiting for ya in the water, dude...
They're creepin' up closer, and closer, and closer...
It smells... fishy..
Don't be scared, I can tell.
It's the prize you seek.
finish: *[Behind Sandy, you can see waves crash wildly against the bridge, bringing a powerful aura to your arrival]*
Oh, wonderous beekeeper... Oh dearest compadre... You, have completed the greatest challenge of mine yet...
CON-GRAAAAAAAAAAADULATIONS!!!!
*[Fanfare plays, loud applause]*
YOU'VE DONE IT! You've completed all TWENTY Summerfest Challenges!!!
*[Confetti Cannon shoots behind you, getting all over your gear and bees]*
THAT is how to become a TRUE, Summerfest champ! Way to go, little buddy!!!
You must be EAGARLY waiting for your grand, limited prize, haven't 'cha? Been on your mind since the beginning I'm sure!
Well, lil' dude. You've finally earned it.
For your grand prize, you're getting your very own...
SHARK BEE!!
This lil' guy will be VERY helpful for your pollen collecting journey, as well as your bestest friend!
Just bee a teeensy bit careful, he's a biter! Hahaha! Only love bites, promise!
Well bud, looks like we've come to the end of our event. Time to wrap it up and go home...
JUST KIDDING! I'll still be around for a while, don't worry! This event goes on for as long as the summer sun shines!
And this won't be the only time you'll see me, I'll be hostin' PLENTY more Summerfests to come. Feel free to come by for the next one!
Catch ya on the flip side, and rock on, beezy bro! Stay chillin'!~

name: Radiant Bear
description: Radiant Bear basks in the golden light of the Lemon Field, challenging players with increasingly demanding quests centered around honey tokens and tropical crafting.

take: Ahhh, hello there, little one! I sensed your presence from miles away.
I am Radiant Bear, spirit of the bright, golden rays that keeps the flowers in bloom...
My, are you here for something to do? I may have just the thing...
I can tell that you are one for quests.
If you do all of mine, something special shall be given straight from the Sun itself...
*[They gesture to themselves, they chuckle and share a wink.]*
All that's needed is 2,500 Lemon Field Pollen, and 2,500 White Pollen.
A simple start, for a steady heart.
Go forth, little one. May the Sun's Rays bless you with unlimited strength. 🔆
going: Do not retreat to the shade just yet, you still have some collecting to do...
Once a full back of these pollens are complete, then you can come back to me. Don't worry, for I am not leaving yet.
finish: Myy, there you are! And what a filled bag indeed...
Good job on your first task, I cannot promise others will be as easy...
Take a nice, deep breath...
In, and out...
Prepare yourself for what is up ahead.
Relish in the Sunlight while it shines down upon you, little one. 🔆

take: Look up into the sky, little one... Do you see it?
The Great Light of the Sun?
Careful not to blind yourself. Not all eyes can take such brightness as I can...
Feel its warmth beam down onto you... It's choosing you for this task.
50 Boosts of White Pollen given by the Flower bees, and 10,000 White Pollen...
You can do that, can't you? Ohoh, I'm sure you can...
I can already see its completion within my mindspace.
Return to the Light, and let it guide you to your victory. 🔆
going: I can feel much warmth coming off of you, little one...
Put that warmth to good use.
Have enougn time left over for some water to recover, friend...
finish: Yes, yes! Such a magnificant desplay of power, little beekeeper! Good work, good work!
My friend, it is as if you are already a natural... Oh, who am I kidding, of course you are.
That's why the Sun chose you to come meet me, is it not? Hmmhmm...
Keep shining on, little one. May the Sun continue to bless your sweet little soul. 🔆

take: Hmmhm, back again so soon? My my, you really are hungry for a challenge.
It may look simple now, to just continue your progress... If it's a challenge you seek, a challenge you will soon get...
Collect 250 Honey Tokens. Yes, tokens. As well as 100,000 White Pollen, and use up 10 of your seed oils.
The rush of the wind, and silkiness of the oils shall help speed up your process...
The Glory of the Sun only shines brighter, my friend. Keep going. 🔆
going: *[You see them hovering over the ground in a completely relaxed state, eyes closed, taking deep breaths.]
*[Even if they are not looking at you, you can still sense their gaze...]*
finish: *[Small Applaud]* Bravo! Marvelous work, absolutely glorious!
Your rewards shall not go ungiven, you've earned it.
But, do keep going! There's much more to do this Summmerfest, my friend.
You're doing such wonderful work, the Sun thanks you deeply... 🔆

take: Mmmh, such a stunning day as always... Wouldn't you agree?
Hearing the birds chirp in the trees, the critters and flowers Sunbathing in the golden rays, basking in its full glory...
The sea glissing in the sunlight, such a treasure to behold...
Without the Sun, Mother Earth wouldn't be where She stands now... So colorful, so lively.
Now, for you, it is time for your next quest towards glory.
Five Million White Pollen. Two Million, Five Hundred Thousand Pollen from the Lemon Field.
And, to top it off, 300 Honey Tokens...
That's quite the jump, isn't it? Hoho...
Not a moment more to waste, off into the fields you go, friend! The Sun will be right there behind you... 🔆
going: My, do your bees need rest? Do take your time, just don't forget the task at hand...
Summerfest won't last forever, but the sun will...
The Sun is always be here, and will forever watch and protect all of us... 🔆
finish: Ahh, such beauty to behold... Exeillent work, little one.
Feats like this deserve the bestest of rewards.
Stay toasty, little one. Keep yourself safe, for the Sun protects you and your bees. 🔆

take: Here we are, the half-way point... How time fizzles away so quickly.
I hope the light hasn't been too harsh, hmmhm!
We're all in need of more purity in our lives, so I believe its time for more White Pollen...
Twenty Five Million of White, Consume 15 Seed Oils,
and to restore some energy, craft and consume 3 Lemonades.
Perhaps... Bring me a glass of Lemondade as well, Sandy always has the best. Never tasted anything like it...
Into the fields you go, I'm counting on you. So is the Light in the Sky... 🔆
going: Hmmhm, the heat must be getting to you quite a bit, little one...
Wipe off your face with a cold towel, and go grab a refreshment. There is still much work to be done!
finish: Hmmhmmhm my my, what unfiltered strength you have!
Magnificant job, little one. You've made it pass your fifth quest with pride.
Just five more to go, and you'll get your unltimate gift...
Go sunbathe for a while, rest up yourself and your bees... The Sun blesses you with much fortune. 🔆

take: *[You catch Radiant Bear shining witihout end, you shield your eyes as you get close.]*
Hmhmm- oh! My apologies, ahha! First time you've caught me in such a relaxed state! Here, I'll tone it down for a moment.
*[Their light dims down enough for you to see them, but not enough to be fizzled out.]* There, my friend. Are you alright?
When I'm so deep in focus in one place, it's the one time that's hard to focus on anything else!
Here in this forest is the safest place for one like me to do so...
Anywhooo... Here is your next Sun quest, beekeeper...
One Hundred Million White Pollen, 500 Honey Tokens, and 150 Lemons.
Remember my friend, the Sun shall be guiding you on your path to glory. It forsees the end of your quests reaching near... 🔆
going: *[The beaming light off of Radiant Bear is so strong, you can hear the roar of the rays.]
Go now, my friend! For night grows near! Not that it'll stop me from glowing as much as I am, hmmhm.~
finish: *[Gently Chuckles]* Absolutely stellar, little one! The Solar glaze thanks you!
Your kind donations shall not go unrewarded, the Heavenly Rays bless you with these syurpy, sweet gifts...
Such a wonderful display of true connection with your little companions, the power you hold with them brings such undefying joy.
Please, do rest up friend. There's still much to do. Shall you forever feel warmth under the summer skies. 🔆

take: Forgive me, little one... As you near the end, the Sun wishes to see you pushed to your absolute limits.
Let's see if you can get past this next quest without fainting, hmmhm.
Two Hundred Fifty Million White Pollen, and One Hundred Million Lemon Pollen.
Oh my friend, can you handle such heat?
To keep a balance... Create and Consume 2 Majestic Cocktails as well. You must stay replenished with energy.
You are capable, my friend. The Sun continues to gaze, but the tempature is rising... 🔆
going: Come now, come now... It is alright, nothing to be scared of!
It is an honor to have the Sun choose you for these challenges to begin with.
I promise, for your efforts will not be in vain...
finish: *[You see Radiant Bear pooring molten gold into an egg shaped mold, forming a special golden egg.]*
Incredibly done, beekeeper! Such marvolous efforts you've made today!
May your rewards of the Sun be plentiful, friend....
*[They cool the egg off instantly with a wave of their paw, and gives to you with such gentle grace.]*
This here Golden Egg is unlike any other you find, for it has been Sunkissed by the Light itself!
Now, prepare yourself and your bees for these upcoming quests... for the Sun is soon reaching its absolute zenith! 🔆

take: Hmmhmhmm... Not even the night can prevent the Sun's beam from shining down. Wouldn't you agree?
After all, the Moon's perfect, white exterior reflects the Sun's Rays so, so gorgeously at night...
You, my friend, are as unstoppable as those Rays of Light...
Piercing beautifully through the night sky.
Now it is time for your next quest, I truly do hope you are prepared...
Five Hundred Million White Pollen, Two Hundred Fifty Million Lemon, 1,000 Honey Tokens and 2 Majestic Cocktails...
You've made it this far into these quests, just a little ways more...
The luck of the Sun shall be by your side. 🔆
going: The grind is rough, the grind is punishing... But the reward is worth it all.
And this isn't even all of the quests, friend. Keep pushing forward...
finish: Come, come. Let me see your progress...
Yes.. Yes! You've done it, my friend. You're so close to the end now.
My, you really hold yourself up well, don't you?
I, as well the Light above are very proud of your efforts. Don't ever give up, little one. 🔆

take: My goodness, what a venture this has been. Only one more quest after this before your gracious gift...
You've got this, little one. Please, keep believing in yourself!
Here's all you need to do for your penultimate challenge...
Seventy Five Hundred Million White Pollen, Twenty Five Hundred Thousand Lemon Pollen...
1,000 Honey Tokens, and 3 Majestic Cocktails.
Not much more compared to the last, about the same, really... But still a challenge nonetheless.
Go forth, your journey is almost complete...
going: It may be a large feat, but never impossible. You've collected so much before.
Be sure to drink up those Cocktails, they'll keep you nice and refreshed.
finish: Oh, magnificant! You've done it again, haha!
Ohh even with all you've done, you still manage to surprise me. We're very impressed!
And now, you are closer to the final task than ever before... I promise, you will adore this gift.
May the Rays of the Sun give you much needed rest... 🔆

take: Mhmm yess, yes... It is time, my friend. Your final quest has arrived!
I am so proud of the efforts and goals you've achieved thus far, but now it is time to give it all you've got!
Let's not waste any time! One Billion White Pollen! Yes, One Billion specs of purity!
500 Zestful Lemons, and a Majestic Cocktail to top it all off... Both created, and consumed...
You've made it, you're here... It's time to use all of your power that the sun has blessed you with. 🔆
going: Let that burning fire within inspire you, the gift that awaits you at the end of this journey...
For it is something worth every bit of essence of energy...
finish: Mmhhmhmhmmm...
Just as I foresaw, you've done it... You've beaten every challenged laid out for you, the Sun is VERY pleased...
I knew, from the very moment you came to me, you'd outshine it all.
Look at you... You're even stronger, more powerful than before! That's nothing to shrug off, friend!
Now, your gift... Your final reward for all of your efforts...
*[A bright essence glows within the middle of their paws, hovering above ground in a spherical shape.]*
*[The circular glow forms into a bee shape, and then, after some seconds pass...]*
*[BAM! A split second of bright light flashes across the area, and as soon as you gain your vision back, you see them...]*
*[A radiently glowing bee hovers before you.]*
With the full extent of my power, I present to you... Sunny Bee...
The rays of this elegent bee will greatly help your collecting journey. Please, take good care of them for me...
As for me, I will remain right here for the rest of Summerfest. I am certain this won't be the last time we see each other.
Thank you for your presence, for I even I have been blessed by it... You truly are a special gift.
The Sun lays its kiss upon your head, blessing your journey with true friendship... 🔆

name: Botanist Bear
description: Botanist Bear is a wise and nurturing character who specializes in quests that involve gathering pollen and tokens from various fields. Completing her quests rewards players with honey and unique items.
noquest_dialog: I already have everything I need for now, sweetie.
But make sure to come back later for more~

take: Ohoho, hey there, darling!
Come in, come in, the tea is just about ready.
Hohoho~ You must be the child that Berry can't stop talking about.
I am Botanist Bear, but my real name is Delilah. A pleasure to meet you~
If it's quests you came for, then quests you shall receive! Simple enough, I believe.
You see, my flowers are a little... special.
They actually grow by absorbing pollen!
Oh? Just like Snowflake's Snowdrops you say?
Actually... I am the reason his flowers can do that!
Well, with a bit of help from Silvane, but who cares~
Alright, back to the main topic.
I'm not as strong as I was in my youth, so I'm no longer able to do it all alone.
I would appreciate an extra set of hands here and there.
Oh! Another thing you must know before we get started.
You see this board right here next to me? This is the leaderboard of just how many of my quests you've completed!
Now, you can do them as many times as you wish, doesn't need to be that many.
Each time you finish, it'll count how many quests you've finished!
See you out in the fields, my dear! Be gentle with the flowers~
going: Now, now... Don't come back with an empty hand!
This is just the beginning, little one.
finish: Just as capable as Berry described...
Thank you, deary.~ Here's a little something for your efforts.
Do make sure to come back in a few moments, though.
I still have a lot of work that needs to be done!

take: Oh! Good timing, darling!
I’m so glad you stopped by, as I’ve been in a bit of a tizzy trying to manage the Wisteria Field on my own.
My Azure Bells are looking a bit hungry too, and I need Blue Pollen to keep them happy!
Could you be a dear and gather a bunch of it from the Wisteria Field for me?
Thank you, honey~
going: Toodle-loo, my dear!
Do be careful not to work yourself to exhaustion!
I’ll be right here with the kettle whistling and a fresh pot of tea waiting for your return.
finish: Oh my. That was fast.
My Azure Bells are gonna love this!
These flowers are incredibly sensitive to vibrations.
Because of that, humming a soft lullaby into them produces a unique sound!
It's almost like they are singing with you... How absolutely adorable.

take: Hi darling~.
I'm feeling ever so busy today, and it seems like the Blossom Field needs a little trimming.
Hmm... seems like my Snow-Whisp Lilies need a really good feeding as well...
Could you be a dear and take care of the Blossom Field?
Bring some White Pollen while you are at it as well.
That should be just enough to keep the Snow-Whisp Lilies glowing for a while!
Off you go, my little petal!
going: Toodle-loo, my dear!
Do be careful not to work yourself to exhaustion!
I’ll be right here with the kettle whistling and a fresh pot of tea waiting for your return.
finish: Beautiful, absolutely stellar work!
My Snow-Whisp Lilies are going to love this!
They are bioluminescent and have a soft, pearly white glow during the night, so they act as natural lanterns for the garden.
Also, even in the middle of a hot summer day, these lilies remain ice-cold to the touch!
I actually use them to keep my tea cool.
Hm? You find it weird that I like cool tea?
Eeh, who cares. It's all about preference!

take: Hi again, my sweet little sunshine!
The Crimson Heart-Blooms are being absolute divas today.
They refuse to show their true colors unless they are fed some Red Pollen.
They crave pollen from the Lotus Field, however, there's a small problem...
Actually, a big one. A dangerous butterfly appeared out of nowhere.
And as you can probably guess, I can't take care of it alone.
If it isn't too much trouble, could you help this old granny?
going: Toodle-loo, my dear!
Do be careful not to work yourself to exhaustion!
I’ll be right here with the kettle whistling and a fresh pot of tea waiting for your return.
finish: Oh, you've done it! Simply radiant!
You also took care of that pesky butterfly! Splendid job!
Ohh don't get me wrong dear, I do enjoy the butterflies, they're a beautiful bunch of insects.
Just not when they're out bothering my flowers!
I'm sure they understand my protection over my dearies, don't they?
My Crimson Heart-Blooms are just glowing with joy now.
Did you notice how they pulsate? They have a little heartbeat of their own, you know.
When hungry, they become grey and their heartbeat slows down, so we don't want their glowy, crimson red to disappear!
The pollen is so vibrant, I have to be careful not to stain my favorite apron!
Hohoho~ I see you've got some on your nose, how adorable~

take: Oh, hey again, my little poppet!
I’m having a bit of a struggle with my Honey-Suckle Snapdragons today.
They are such greedy little things; they won't open their mouths unless they've had a proper gourmet meal!
Could you craft some Strawberry Extracts for me and gather a whole lot of Red Pollen?
I need to mix them together to create a sweet, sticky nectar that they just can't resist!
going: Toodle-loo, my dear!
Do be careful not to work yourself to exhaustion!
I’ll be right here with the kettle whistling and a fresh pot of tea waiting for your return.
finish: Oh, you absolute star! Thank you, sweetie.
Look at that mixture! It's the perfect consistency. Thick, sweet, and perfectly red.
The Honey-Suckle Snapdragons are already wiggling their stems in anticipation.
They know a good meal when they smell it!
It’s hard work, I know, but these little gluttons are worth the trouble.
Here, take this as a token of my appreciation!

take: Ohoho, sweet pea, you’re just in time!
My Sapphire Lotuses turned a dreadfully pale shade of blue and started to close up.
They are actually quite hard to please, since they need a combination of Blueberry Extracts and Blue Pollen.
Could you be a dear and go satisfy their little whims for me?
Off you go, my little sprout!
going: Toodle-loo, my dear!
Do be careful not to work yourself to exhaustion!
I’ll be right here with the kettle whistling and a fresh pot of tea waiting for your return.
finish: Oh, marvelous! You truly are a lifesaver, my child.
This extract is the perfect color, a deep, rich blue that smells like a summer rainstorm.
As soon as I pour this over my Sapphire Lotuses, they will start regaining their color and open up.
This flower can produce water, one of the cleanest waters you could find actually!
Meaning, I have an infinite water supply!
But they do require quite a bit of attention, so I don't think I could manage these finicky things without some help.
You're a natural at this, my dear!

take: Welcome back, pumpkin!
I’m having a bit of a panic, my Clockwork Blooms are starting to tick a little sluggishly.
They are such marvelous flowers! They show the exact time of day, and I’d be completely lost without them to keep my tea schedule on track!
Could you help me with some Cone Extracts and White Pollen?
I need the extract to lubricate their gears and the pollen to calibrate their hands.
going: Toodle-loo, my dear!
Do be careful not to work yourself to exhaustion!
I’ll be right here with the kettle whistling and a fresh pot of tea waiting for your return.
finish: Simply marvelous! You’re an absolute angel.
My Clockwork Blooms are back in perfect sync, listen to that steady rhythm!
It really is fascinating, isn't it? As the day goes on, their petals actually shift position like clock hands.
I never miss a tea break when they're properly fed, and that’s the most important thing in life, don't you agree?

take: Oh, you look a bit worn down, my dear! You’ve been working far too hard for me.
I think I have just the thing to help you regain your strength!
While messing with the ingredients for my flowers, I found an interesting interaction that the extracts have with eachother.
I need you to consume them all at once so your system can absorb the properties and restore your vitality.
It works even faster if you exercise, so may I still give you the task of collecting some pollen for me?
*Player Nods*
Yes? Oh! What a sweet little gentleman you are!
going: Toodle-loo, my dear!
Do be careful not to work yourself to exhaustion!
I’ll be right here with the kettle whistling and a fresh pot of tea waiting for your return.
finish: Oh, goodness! You look so much better now! The color has returned to your cute little cheeks!
That secret recipe really is like a miracle, isn't it?
I’m so relieved you’re feeling better.
I would never forgive myself if you got sick while helping me out.
